  // The program implements the tool logic and returns a JSON result
  
  if (toolName === 'web_search') {
    // web_search runs the Tavily API via fetch() inside a Dynamic Worker
    const searchCode = `
export default {
  async fetch(request) {
    const { query, maxResults = 5 } = await request.json();
    const resp = await fetch('https://api.tavily.com/search', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        api_key: TAVILY_KEY,
        query,
        max_results: maxResults,
        search_depth: 'advanced'
      })
    });
    const data = await resp.json();
    return Response.json({ results: data.results ?? [] });
  }
}`;
    const loaderDO = context.env.NAELAO_DW_LOADER.get(
      context.env.NAELAO_DW_LOADER.idFromName(`tier2:${context.spaceId}`)
    );
    const result = await loaderDO.fetch(new Request('http://loader/execute', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: JSON.stringify({
        code: searchCode,
        input: { query: params.query, maxResults: parseInt(params.maxResults ?? '5') },
        bindings: { TAVILY_KEY: context.env.TAVILY_API_KEY }
      })
    }));
    return { output: await result.json() };
  }

  if (toolName === 'api_call') {
    // Delegated to the api-caller platform skill (also Tier 2, cf-worker type)
    // SSRF protection enforced inside handleApiCall()
    return handleApiCall({
      url: params.url,
      method: params.method ?? 'GET',
      headers: params.headers ? JSON.parse(params.headers) : {},
      body: params.body,
      spaceId: context.spaceId
    }, context.env);
  }

  throw new Error(`Unknown Tier 2 tool: ${toolName}`);
}

Tier 3 — NPM (Isolate + Runtime Package Resolution)

Cost: ~$0.0005 per million CPU-ms (slightly higher due to package resolution). Cold start: <10ms. Limit: Node-compatible npm packages only, no native binaries.

Tier 3 is Tier 2 with runtime npm package access. Use when the task needs a TypeScript library that isn't available natively (e.g., a specific date parsing library, a Markdown parser, a ZIP file handler). Package resolution happens at load time, not at runtime — Cloudflare's infrastructure resolves the packages before the isolate starts.

// Tier 3 — same as Tier 2 but with npm package imports
// The Dynamic Worker Loader resolves packages at load time
const tier3Code = `
import { marked } from 'marked';     // npm package — resolved by DW Loader
import JSZip from 'jszip';           // npm package

export default {
  async fetch(request) {
    const { markdown } = await request.json();
    const html = marked.parse(markdown);
    return Response.json({ html });
  }
}`;

// Declare npm dependencies in the code comment so DW Loader knows to resolve them
// The DW Loader parses import statements and pre-resolves packages
// This is why Tier 3 is slightly slower to start than Tier 2 — package resolution

Tier 4 — Browser (CF Browser Rendering via CDP)

Cost: ~$0.02 per 1000 requests (CF Browser Rendering pricing). Cold start: ~100-200ms (Chrome instance). Limit: Web pages only — cannot access the container filesystem or run arbitrary code.

Tier 4 is specifically for web browser automation. Navigate URLs, click elements, fill forms, take screenshots, extract structured data from rendered pages (including JavaScript-heavy SPAs). This uses CF Browser Rendering — managed headless Chrome at Cloudflare's edge. The naelao-browser Worker provides a CDP proxy shim that exposes a simplified API to agents.

// workers/browser/index.ts — The Moltworker-pattern CDP proxy
// Agents call this via MCP tool call, not directly.
// The naelao-browser Worker provides a stable API over the raw CDP protocol.

export default {
  async fetch(request: Request, env: Env): Promise<Response> {
    const url = new URL(request.url);
    const { spaceId, action, params } = await request.json();

    // Validate space access before opening any browser session
    await validateSpaceAccess(request, spaceId, env);

    // Open a browser session via CF Browser Rendering
    // Sessions are scoped per request — no session state persists between tool calls
    const browser = await puppeteer.launch(env.NAELAO_BROWSER);
    const page = await browser.newPage();

    try {
      switch (action) {
        case 'navigate_and_extract': {
          await page.goto(params.url, { waitUntil: 'networkidle0', timeout: 30000 });
          const title = await page.title();
          const text = await page.evaluate(() => document.body.innerText);
          const links = await page.evaluate(() =>
            Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a[href]'))
              .map(a => ({ text: a.textContent?.trim(), href: (a as HTMLAnchorElement).href }))
              .slice(0, 50)  // limit to 50 links to avoid huge payloads
          );
          return Response.json({ title, text: text.slice(0, 10000), links });
        }
        case 'screenshot': {
          await page.goto(params.url, { waitUntil: 'networkidle0', timeout: 30000 });
          const screenshot = await page.screenshot({ type: 'png', fullPage: params.fullPage ?? false });
          // Store screenshot in R2 and return the R2 key
          // Agents can then use read_file to retrieve it or pass the key to artifact-builder
          const screenshotKey = `spaces/${spaceId}/workspace/screenshots/${Date.now()}.png`;
          await env.NAELAO_WORKSPACE.put(screenshotKey, screenshot);
          return Response.json({ screenshotPath: screenshotKey.replace(`spaces/${spaceId}/`, '') });
        }
        case 'fill_form': {
          await page.goto(params.url, { waitUntil: 'networkidle0', timeout: 30000 });
          for (const [selector, value] of Object.entries(params.fields as Record<string, string>)) {
            await page.type(selector, value);
          }
          if (params.submitSelector) {
            await page.click(params.submitSelector);
            await page.waitForNavigation({ timeout: 15000 });
          }
          return Response.json({ success: true, finalUrl: page.url() });
        }
        default:
          return Response.json({ error: `Unknown browser action: ${action}` }, { status: 400 });
      }
    } finally {
      await browser.close(); // ALWAYS close — leaked sessions accumulate costs
    }
  }
};

Tier 5 — Sandbox (CF Container, Full Linux)

Cost: ~$0.015/hr (standard-1: ½ vCPU, 4 GiB RAM). Cold start: 2-3 seconds. Idle: Sleeps after 10 minutes, R2 persists all state. Limit: Nothing — full Linux with Python, Node, Bash, git, and any package.

Tier 5 is the container. Use only when the task genuinely needs a Linux environment: running Python scripts with numpy/pandas, executing Bash commands, running a local web server, compiling code, or any task that needs a real filesystem, installed system tools, or native binaries.

// durable-objects/sandbox-do.ts — Complete SandboxDO implementation

export class SandboxDO extends DurableObject {
  private containerRef: SandboxStub | null = null;
  private lastActiveAt: number = 0;

  private async initSchema() {
    this.ctx.storage.sql.exec(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS exec_log (
        id         TEXT PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT (lower(hex(randomblob(16)))),
        command    TEXT NOT NULL,
        exit_code  INTEGER,
        stdout     TEXT,
        stderr     TEXT,
        duration_ms INTEGER,
        executed_at INTEGER DEFAULT (unixepoch('now') * 1000)
      );
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS container_state (
        key   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        value TEXT NOT NULL
      );
      INSERT OR IGNORE INTO container_state VALUES ('status', 'stopped');
      INSERT OR IGNORE INTO container_state VALUES ('last_started', '0');
    `);
  }

  async fetch(request: Request): Promise<Response> {
    const url = new URL(request.url);
    
    if (url.pathname === '/ensure-running') return this.ensureRunning(request);
    if (url.pathname === '/exec')           return this.exec(request);
    if (url.pathname === '/status')         return this.getStatus();
    if (url.pathname === '/stop')           return this.stop();
    
    return new Response('Not Found', { status: 404 });
  }

  private async ensureRunning(request: Request): Promise<Response> {
    const { spaceId, projectId } = await request.json();
    
    const status = this.ctx.storage.sql
      .exec("SELECT value FROM container_state WHERE key = 'status'")
      .one()?.value as string;
    
    if (status === 'running' && this.containerRef) {
      this.lastActiveAt = Date.now();
      return Response.json({ status: 'already_running' });
    }

    // Start the container via CF Sandbox SDK
    // Container name includes spaceId for isolation (Layer 6 of tenant isolation)
    const containerName = this.buildContainerName(spaceId, projectId);
    const sandbox = getSandbox(this.env.NAELAO_SANDBOX, containerName);
    
    // Mount R2 as /workspace — THIS IS THE KEY STEP
    // Without this, the container has no access to the agent's files.
    // After mount, ALL files in spaces/{spaceId}/workspace/ appear at /workspace/
    await sandbox.mountBucket(this.env.NAELAO_WORKSPACE, '/workspace', {
      prefix: `spaces/${spaceId}/projects/${projectId}/workspace/`
    });

    // Run the container sync script inside the container
    // This sets up the WebSocket back-channel and applies permission manifest
    await sandbox.exec('bash', ['/opt/naelao/container-sync.sh'], {
      env: {
        SPACE_ID: spaceId,
        PROJECT_ID: projectId,
        NAELAO_INTERNAL_TOKEN: this.env.NAELAO_INTERNAL_TOKEN,
        AGENT_DO_ID: this.agentDoId ?? ''
      }
    });

    this.containerRef = sandbox;
    this.lastActiveAt = Date.now();

    this.ctx.storage.sql.exec(
      "UPDATE container_state SET value = ? WHERE key = 'status'", 'running'
    );
    this.ctx.storage.sql.exec(
      "UPDATE container_state SET value = ? WHERE key = 'last_started'", Date.now().toString()
    );

    // Set alarm to check for idle timeout (10 minutes)
    // If the container hasn't been used, it sleeps and costs stop
    await this.ctx.storage.setAlarm(Date.now() + 10 * 60 * 1000);

    return Response.json({ status: 'started', containerName });
  }

  private async exec(request: Request): Promise<Response> {
    if (!this.containerRef) {
      return Response.json({ error: 'Container not running. Call /ensure-running first.' }, { status: 409 });
    }

    const { command, args, env: extraEnv, workingDir } = await request.json();
    const startMs = Date.now();

    // Validate path if working directory is specified
    const cwd = workingDir ? validateContainerPath(workingDir) : '/workspace';

    try {
      // ALWAYS use argument arrays — never string interpolation (CVE-2026-24763)
      const result = await this.containerRef.exec(command, args, {
        env: extraEnv,
        cwd
      });

      const duration = Date.now() - startMs;
      this.lastActiveAt = Date.now();

      // Log execution for audit (not optional)
      this.ctx.storage.sql.exec(
        'INSERT INTO exec_log (command, exit_code, stdout, stderr, duration_ms) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',
        `${command} ${args.join(' ')}`,
        result.exitCode,
        (result.stdout ?? '').slice(0, 10000),  // truncate large outputs
        (result.stderr ?? '').slice(0, 5000),
        duration
      );

      return Response.json({
        exitCode: result.exitCode,
        stdout: result.stdout ?? '',
        stderr: result.stderr ?? '',
        durationMs: duration
      });
    } catch (error) {
      return Response.json({
        error: `Execution failed: ${(error as Error).message}`,
        exitCode: -1
      }, { status: 500 });
    }
  }

  // Alarm handler — called when idle timeout fires
  async alarm(): Promise<void> {
    const idleMs = Date.now() - this.lastActiveAt;
    const IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS = 10 * 60 * 1000; // 10 minutes

    if (idleMs >= IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS && this.containerRef) {
      // Container has been idle — let it sleep
      // R2 mount persists — when container restarts, all files are still there
      this.containerRef = null;
      this.ctx.storage.sql.exec(
        "UPDATE container_state SET value = 'stopped' WHERE key = 'status'"
      );
    } else {
      // Still active — reset alarm
      await this.ctx.storage.setAlarm(Date.now() + IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS - idleMs);
    }
  }

  private buildContainerName(spaceId: string, projectId: string): string {
    // Short, deterministic, includes spaceId for isolation
    // Format: naelao-{8char spaceId}-{8char projectId}
    const sp = spaceId.replace(/-/g, '').slice(0, 8);
    const pj = projectId.replace(/-/g, '').slice(0, 8);
    return `naelao-${sp}-${pj}`;
  }
}

// Path traversal validation (from §19 Security)
function validateContainerPath(agentPath: string): string {
  const { resolve, normalize } = require('path');
  const WORKSPACE_ROOT = '/workspace';
  const normalized = normalize(agentPath);
  const absolute = resolve(WORKSPACE_ROOT, normalized.startsWith('/') ? normalized.slice(1) : normalized);
  if (!absolute.startsWith(WORKSPACE_ROOT + '/') && absolute !== WORKSPACE_ROOT) {
    throw new Error(`Path traversal blocked: "${agentPath}" resolves outside /workspace`);
  }
  return absolute;
}

Execution Ladder Routing in Orchestrator

// agentpress/orchestrator.ts — The full routing logic
// This is called on EVERY tool execution. Get it right.

// Rule: tools are assigned a tier in TOOL_TIERS.
// If a tool isn't in TOOL_TIERS, default to Tier 5 (safest but most expensive).
// Agents cannot override tier assignments — this is a platform-level decision.

export async function routeAndExecute(
  toolCall: ParsedToolCall,
  context: ToolContext
): Promise<ToolResult> {
  const toolName = toolCall.toolName;
  const tier = TOOL_TIERS[toolName]?.tier ?? 'sandbox'; // default to Tier 5

  switch (tier) {
    case 'workspace':
      return executeTier1Tool(toolName, toolCall.parameters, context);
    
    case 'isolate':
      return executeTier2Tool(toolName, toolCall.parameters, context);
    
    case 'npm':
      return executeTier3Tool(toolName, toolCall.parameters, context);
    
    case 'browser':
      // Browser tools call naelao-browser Worker via Service Binding
      return context.env.NAELAO_BROWSER_SVC.fetch(new Request('http://browser/execute', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({ spaceId: context.spaceId, action: toolName, params: toolCall.parameters })
      })).then(r => r.json());
    
    case 'sandbox':
      // Ensure container is running before dispatching any sandbox tool
      if (!context.sandboxStarted) {
        await context.sandboxDO.fetch(new Request('http://sandbox/ensure-running', {
          method: 'POST',
          body: JSON.stringify({ spaceId: context.spaceId, projectId: context.projectId })
        }));
        context.sandboxStarted = true; // only start once per agent loop iteration
      }
      return context.sandboxDO.fetch(new Request('http://sandbox/exec', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({ command: toolName, args: Object.values(toolCall.parameters) })
      })).then(r => r.json());
    
    default:
      throw new Error(`Unknown execution tier: ${tier} for tool: ${toolName}`);
  }
}
28 — naelao-threads: Implementation

naelao-threads — Complete Implementation Reference

naelao-threads is the Worker responsible for every thread and message operation: creating threads, persisting messages, paginating history, streaming LLM tokens to the client, and managing the reconnect buffer. It seems simple but has several non-obvious implementation requirements that junior developers commonly get wrong.

Complete Thread Worker Implementation

// workers/threads/index.ts
// naelao-threads Worker — all thread and message operations.
// Called via Service Binding from naelao-router.
// NEVER called directly from the browser — always through naelao-router.

// No Supabase client import — data access is via SpaceDO Service Binding
// import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js'; // REMOVED

export default {
  async fetch(request: Request, env: Env): Promise<Response> {
    const url = new URL(request.url);
    const spaceId = request.headers.get('X-Space-Id') ?? '';
    const userId  = request.headers.get('X-User-Id') ?? '';
    
    // spaceId MUST be present — naelao-auth set it on the header
    // If it's missing, this request bypassed auth — reject it
    if (!spaceId || !/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/.test(spaceId)) {
      return new Response('Missing or invalid X-Space-Id header', { status: 400 });
    }

    const spaceDO = getProductDO(rootSpaceId, env);  // per-product SpaceDO

    const path = url.pathname;

    if (path === '/threads' && request.method === 'POST')
      return createThread(request, spaceDO, spaceId, userId);
    
    if (path.match(/^\/threads\/[^/]+$/) && request.method === 'GET')
      return getThread(url, spaceDO, spaceId);
    
    if (path.match(/^\/threads\/[^/]+\/messages$/) && request.method === 'GET')
      return getMessages(url, spaceDO, spaceId);
    
    if (path.match(/^\/threads\/[^/]+\/messages$/) && request.method === 'POST')
      return addMessage(request, url, db, spaceId, userId, env);
    
    if (path.match(/^\/threads\/[^/]+\/stream$/) && request.method === 'GET')
      return openStreamConnection(url, db, spaceId, env);

    return new Response('Not Found', { status: 404 });
  }
};

async function createThread(
  request: Request,
  spaceDO: DurableObjectStub,  // SpaceDO replaces SupabaseClient
  spaceId: string,
  userId: string
): Promise<Response> {
  const { projectId, title, agentDefinitionId } = await request.json();

  // Validate projectId belongs to this space (double check beyond RLS)
  const { data: project } = await db
    .from('projects')
    .select('id')
    .eq('id', projectId)
    .eq('space_id', spaceId)  // withSpace() pattern
    .single();
  
  if (!project) {
    return Response.json({ error: 'Project not found in this space' }, { status: 404 });
  }

  const threadId = crypto.randomUUID();
  const { data: thread, error } = await db
    .from('threads')
    .insert({
      id: threadId,
      project_id: projectId,
      space_id: spaceId,          // ALWAYS include space_id on insert
      created_by: userId,
      title: title ?? 'New Thread',
      agent_definition_id: agentDefinitionId,
      status: 'active'
    })
    .select()
    .single();

  if (error) {
    return Response.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }

  return Response.json(thread, { status: 201 });
}

async function getMessages(
  url: URL,
  spaceDO: DurableObjectStub,  // SpaceDO replaces SupabaseClient
  spaceId: string
): Promise<Response> {
  const threadId = url.pathname.split('/')[2];
  const before = url.searchParams.get('before');  // cursor-based pagination
  const limit  = Math.min(parseInt(url.searchParams.get('limit') ?? '50'), 100);

  let query = db
    .from('messages')
    .select('*')
    .eq('thread_id', threadId)
    .eq('space_id', spaceId)    // withSpace() equivalent
    .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
    .limit(limit);

  if (before) {
    // Cursor pagination — fetch messages BEFORE this timestamp
    // This is more efficient than offset pagination for chat history
    query = query.lt('created_at', before);
  }

  const { data: messages, error } = await query;
  if (error) return Response.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });

  return Response.json({
    messages: (messages ?? []).reverse(), // reverse to chronological order
    hasMore: (messages?.length ?? 0) === limit,
    nextCursor: messages?.[0]?.created_at ?? null
  });
}

async function openStreamConnection(
  url: URL,
  spaceDO: DurableObjectStub,  // SpaceDO replaces SupabaseClient
  spaceId: string,
  env: Env
): Promise<Response> {
  const threadId = url.pathname.split('/')[2];

  // Verify thread belongs to this space before connecting to its AgentDO
  const { data: thread } = await db
    .from('threads')
    .select('id, project_id, agent_definition_id')
    .eq('id', threadId)
    .eq('space_id', spaceId)
    .single();

  if (!thread) {
    return Response.json({ error: 'Thread not found in this space' }, { status: 404 });
  }

  // Upgrade to WebSocket for streaming
  // naelao-threads proxies the WebSocket to the AgentDO
  // The client connects here; naelao-threads forwards to the DO
  const upgradeHeader = url.searchParams.get('upgrade');
  if (upgradeHeader !== 'websocket') {
    // If not WebSocket, return SSE stream (for clients that don't support WS)
    return createSSEStream(thread, env, spaceId);
  }

  // WebSocket — proxy to AgentDO
  const agentDoId = env.NAELAO_AGENT_DO.idFromName(
    `${spaceId}:${thread.project_id}:${threadId}`
  );
  const agentDO = env.NAELAO_AGENT_DO.get(agentDoId);

  // Forward the WebSocket upgrade request to the DO
  // The DO handles hibernation, buffering, and broadcasting
  return agentDO.fetch(url.toString(), { headers: { Upgrade: 'websocket' } });
}

function createSSEStream(thread: Thread, env: Env, spaceId: string): Response {
  // SSE (Server-Sent Events) for clients that prefer it over WebSocket
  // Less efficient for long sessions but simpler to implement in some frontends
  const { readable, writable } = new TransformStream();
  const writer = writable.getWriter();
  const encoder = new TextEncoder();

  // Connect to AgentDO via WebSocket internally and forward events as SSE
  void (async () => {
    const agentDoId = env.NAELAO_AGENT_DO.idFromName(
      `${spaceId}:${thread.project_id}:${thread.id}`
    );
    const agentDO = env.NAELAO_AGENT_DO.get(agentDoId);
    const wsResp = await agentDO.fetch('http://agent/connect', {
      headers: { Upgrade: 'websocket' }
    });
    const ws = wsResp.webSocket!;
    ws.accept();
    ws.addEventListener('message', (evt) => {
      const data = encoder.encode(`data: ${evt.data}\n\n`);
      writer.write(data);
    });
    ws.addEventListener('close', () => writer.close());
  })();

  return new Response(readable, {
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream',
      'Cache-Control': 'no-cache',
      'Connection': 'keep-alive',
    }
  });
}

Why Cursor Pagination (Not Offset) for Chat History

⚠ Common Junior Dev Mistake: Offset Pagination for Chat

Using LIMIT 50 OFFSET 100 for chat history seems intuitive but breaks in a real chat app. When a new message arrives while the user is scrolling up through history, all offsets shift. Messages skip or duplicate.

Correct approach: Cursor-based pagination using the created_at timestamp as the cursor. WHERE created_at < {cursor} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50. The cursor is the timestamp of the oldest message the client has. New messages arriving don't affect this query at all.

The nextCursor in the response is the created_at of the oldest message returned. The client sends this as the before parameter on the next request to load older messages.

29 — File Manager Skill

file-manager — The Agent's Primary File Interface

The file-manager skill is the most-used skill in the platform. Every agent that creates output, reads input, or maintains state uses it. It runs entirely at Tier 1 (direct R2 operations) — no compute isolate, no container. Here is every tool it provides, with exact implementation for each.

file-manager SKILL.md

---
name: file-manager
description: >
  Read, write, list, move, copy, and delete files in the agent workspace.
  Use this skill for ANY file operation. The workspace is persistent across
  all sessions — files you write today are available in future sessions.
  
  When to use: storing results, reading input data, creating reports,
  maintaining todo.md, reading knowledge documents, saving generated code.
  
  File paths are relative to /workspace. Example: 'output/report.md'
  refers to /workspace/output/report.md.
  
  Maximum file size for read/write: 100MB. For larger files, use streaming.

metadata:
  naelao:
    tier: 1
    resource: workspace
    version: "2.0.0"
    security:
      sha256: "computed_at_signing_time"
      verified_by: platform
      sandbox_only: false
    context_injection:
      always: true
      format: xml
      max_tokens: 300
---

# File Manager

## Available Operations
- **read_file**: Read file contents. Returns text content.
- **write_file**: Write content to file. Creates parent directories automatically.
- **list_directory**: List files and folders at a path. Supports recursive listing.
- **delete_file**: Delete a file. Asks for confirmation before deleting.
- **move_file**: Move or rename a file.
- **file_exists**: Check if a file exists without reading it.
- **get_file_metadata**: Get file size, modification date, MIME type.
- **append_to_file**: Append content to end of file without reading the whole thing.

## Best Practices
1. Always check if a file exists with file_exists before reading it
2. For large writes, consider writing to a temp file first and then moving it
3. Keep todo.md at the root of workspace as your persistent planning file
4. Put final deliverables in /workspace/output/ so the user can find them easily
5. Never write sensitive data (API keys, passwords) to workspace files

Complete file-manager Tool Implementations

// skills/platform/file-manager/implementation.ts
// This runs at Tier 1 — inside the Worker handling the MCP tool call.
// No isolate, no container. Direct R2 operations via SpaceR2.
// Target latency: <50ms for reads, <100ms for writes (includes version recording).

export const FILE_MANAGER_TOOLS: MCPTool[] = [
  {
    name: 'read_file',
    description: 'Read the contents of a file from the workspace',
    inputSchema: {
      type: 'object',
      properties: {
        path: { type: 'string', description: 'File path relative to workspace root' },
        encoding: { type: 'string', enum: ['text', 'base64'], default: 'text' }
      },
      required: ['path']
    },
    async handler(params, ctx) {
      validateRelativePath(params.path);
      const r2 = new SpaceR2(ctx.env.NAELAO_WORKSPACE, ctx.spaceId);
      const obj = await r2.get(`workspace/${params.path}`);
      if (!obj) {
        return { content: [{ type: 'text', text: `Error: File not found: ${params.path}` }], isError: true };
      }
      const content = params.encoding === 'base64'
        ? btoa(String.fromCharCode(...new Uint8Array(await obj.arrayBuffer())))
        : await obj.text();
      return { content: [{ type: 'text', text: content }] };
    }
  },

  {
    name: 'write_file',
    description: 'Write content to a file. Creates the file if it does not exist. Creates parent directories automatically.',
    inputSchema: {
      type: 'object',
      properties: {
        path:    { type: 'string', description: 'File path relative to workspace root' },
        content: { type: 'string', description: 'Content to write' },
        encoding:{ type: 'string', enum: ['text', 'base64'], default: 'text' },
        commit_message: { type: 'string', description: 'Optional: describe why this file was written (shown in version history)' }
      },
      required: ['path', 'content']
    },
    async handler(params, ctx) {
      validateRelativePath(params.path);
      
      const contentBytes = params.encoding === 'base64'
        ? Uint8Array.from(atob(params.content), c => c.charCodeAt(0))
        : params.content;

      // Size limit check — prevent very large writes that could time out
      const sizeBytes = typeof contentBytes === 'string'
        ? contentBytes.length
        : contentBytes.byteLength;
      if (sizeBytes > 100 * 1024 * 1024) {
        return { content: [{ type: 'text', text: 'Error: File exceeds 100MB limit. Split into smaller files.' }], isError: true };
      }

      await writeFileWithVersioning({
        path: params.path,
        content: contentBytes,
        writtenBy: ctx.agentId,
        spaceId: ctx.spaceId,
        projectId: ctx.projectId,
        commitMsg: params.commit_message,
        env: ctx.env
      });

      return {
        content: [{
          type: 'text',
          text: `File written successfully: ${params.path} (${sizeBytes} bytes)`
        }]
      };
    }
  },

  {
    name: 'list_directory',
    description: 'List files and directories at a given path',
    inputSchema: {
      type: 'object',
      properties: {
        path:       { type: 'string', description: 'Directory path (empty = workspace root)', default: '' },
        recursive:  { type: 'boolean', description: 'List subdirectories recursively', default: false },
        extensions: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' }, description: 'Filter by file extension, e.g. [".md", ".py"]' }
      }
    },
    async handler(params, ctx) {
      validateRelativePath(params.path ?? '');
      const r2 = new SpaceR2(ctx.env.NAELAO_WORKSPACE, ctx.spaceId);
      const prefix = params.path ? `workspace/${params.path}/` : 'workspace/';
      
      const listing = await r2.list(prefix);
      let files = listing.objects.map(obj => {
        const relativePath = obj.key.replace(
          `spaces/${ctx.spaceId}/workspace/`, ''
        );
        return {
          path: relativePath,
          name: relativePath.split('/').pop() ?? relativePath,
          type: 'file' as const,
          size: obj.size,
          modified: obj.uploaded.toISOString()
        };
      });

      // Apply extension filter if provided
      if (params.extensions?.length) {
        files = files.filter(f =>
          params.extensions!.some(ext => f.name.endsWith(ext))
        );
      }

      // If not recursive, only return files directly in the requested dir
      if (!params.recursive && params.path) {
        const depth = params.path.split('/').length + 1;
        files = files.filter(f => f.path.split('/').length === depth);
      }

      return { content: [{ type: 'text', text: JSON.stringify(files, null, 2) }] };
    }
  },

  {
    name: 'append_to_file',
    description: 'Append content to the end of a file. More efficient than read-modify-write for logs and todo lists.',
    inputSchema: {
      type: 'object',
      properties: {
        path:    { type: 'string' },
        content: { type: 'string' }
      },
      required: ['path', 'content']
    },
    async handler(params, ctx) {
      validateRelativePath(params.path);
      const r2 = new SpaceR2(ctx.env.NAELAO_WORKSPACE, ctx.spaceId);
      
      // Read existing content then append
      // For very large files, this could be slow — consider write-only log files instead
      const existing = await r2.get(`workspace/${params.path}`);
      const existingText = existing ? await existing.text() : '';
      const newContent = existingText + params.content;

      await writeFileWithVersioning({
        path: params.path, content: newContent,
        writtenBy: ctx.agentId, spaceId: ctx.spaceId,
        projectId: ctx.projectId, env: ctx.env
      });

      return { content: [{ type: 'text', text: `Appended ${params.content.length} bytes to ${params.path}` }] };
    }
  }
];

// Path validation — called by every file operation
// Blocks path traversal before any R2 operation even starts
function validateRelativePath(path: string): void {
  if (path.includes('..')) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid path: "${path}" — path traversal with '..' is not allowed`);
  }
  if (path.startsWith('/')) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid path: "${path}" — paths must be relative, not starting with '/'`);
  }
  if (path.includes('spaces/')) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid path: "${path}" — paths cannot contain 'spaces/'`);
  }
  // Allow empty string (workspace root) but not just spaces
  if (path.length > 0 && path.trim() !== path) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid path: "${path}" — paths cannot have leading or trailing whitespace`);
  }
}
30 — WalletDO Deep Dive

WalletDO — Every Agent's Economic Engine

WalletDO is used by Workers instances, Space Assistants (when enabled), Enterprise agents, and Mini-AGI nodes. It is the primitive that makes autonomous economic action possible. This section covers every aspect of WalletDO that wasn't covered in §06: the complete policy system, the audit trail, the x402 inter-Space payment protocol, and how to test wallet behavior correctly.

Complete WalletDO Policy System

// durable-objects/wallet-do.ts — Policy management
// Policies are set by Space admins via the dashboard, not by agents.
// Agents can READ policy (to know their limits) but NEVER write policy.
// Policy is enforced atomically inside WalletDO — agents can't bypass it.

export class WalletDO extends DurableObject {

  // Space admin calls this to configure the wallet policy
  async setPolicy(params: {
    maxSingleSpendUsd: number;       // max spend per single transaction
    monthlyBudgetUsd: number;        // total monthly spend limit
    vendorWhitelist: string[];        // [] = allow all, [list] = only these vendors
    categoryCapUsd: Record<string, number>;  // per-category monthly caps
    requireApprovalAboveUsd: number; // amounts above this trigger human approval
    allowedHours?: { from: number; to: number }; // spending hours (UTC, optional)
  }, adminId: string): Promise<void> {

    // Validate all policy values before storing
    if (params.maxSingleSpendUsd < 0 || params.maxSingleSpendUsd > 10000) {
      throw new Error('maxSingleSpendUsd must be between 0 and 10000');
    }
    if (params.monthlyBudgetUsd < 0) {
      throw new Error('monthlyBudgetUsd cannot be negative');
    }

    // Store as individual policy rows for easy querying
    const policyEntries: Array<[string, string]> = [
      ['max_single_spend',          params.maxSingleSpendUsd.toString()],
      ['monthly_budget',            params.monthlyBudgetUsd.toString()],
      ['vendor_whitelist',          JSON.stringify(params.vendorWhitelist)],
      ['category_caps',             JSON.stringify(params.categoryCapUsd)],
      ['require_approval_above',    params.requireApprovalAboveUsd.toString()],
      ['allowed_hours',             JSON.stringify(params.allowedHours ?? null)],
      ['policy_updated_by',         adminId],
      ['policy_updated_at',         Date.now().toString()]
    ];

    for (const [key, value] of policyEntries) {
      this.ctx.storage.sql.exec(
        'INSERT OR REPLACE INTO policy (key, value) VALUES (?, ?)', key, value
      );
    }

    // Log policy change to transactions table for audit
    this.ctx.storage.sql.exec(
      'INSERT INTO transactions (type, amount_usd, description, vendor, balance_after) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',
      'policy_change', 0, `Policy updated by admin ${adminId}`, 'system',
      parseFloat(this.getWalletBalance())
    );
  }

  async getPolicy(): Promise<WalletPolicy> {
    const rows = this.ctx.storage.sql
      .exec('SELECT key, value FROM policy')
      .toArray() as Array<{ key: string; value: string }>;
    const p = Object.fromEntries(rows.map(r => [r.key, r.value]));
    return {
      maxSingleSpendUsd:       parseFloat(p.max_single_spend ?? '10'),
      monthlyBudgetUsd:        parseFloat(p.monthly_budget ?? '100'),
      vendorWhitelist:         JSON.parse(p.vendor_whitelist ?? '[]'),
      categoryCapUsd:          JSON.parse(p.category_caps ?? '{}'),
      requireApprovalAboveUsd: parseFloat(p.require_approval_above ?? '50'),
      allowedHours:            JSON.parse(p.allowed_hours ?? 'null')
    };
  }

  // Get full transaction history for audit/display
  // Returns most recent transactions first with pagination
  async getTransactionHistory(params: {
    limit?: number;
    before?: number;  // timestamp cursor for pagination
    type?: string;    // filter by type: debit|credit|fee|policy_change
  }): Promise<Transaction[]> {
    let query = 'SELECT * FROM transactions';
    const args: unknown[] = [];
    const conditions: string[] = [];
    
    if (params.before) {
      conditions.push('created_at < ?');
      args.push(params.before);
    }
    if (params.type) {
      conditions.push('type = ?');
      args.push(params.type);
    }
    if (conditions.length) query += ' WHERE ' + conditions.join(' AND ');
    query += ' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT ?';
    args.push(params.limit ?? 50);

    return this.ctx.storage.sql.exec(query, ...args).toArray() as Transaction[];
  }

  // Check if spending is allowed right now (time-based policy)
  // Called before every deductCredits() as an additional guard
  private isWithinAllowedHours(allowedHours: { from: number; to: number } | null): boolean {
    if (!allowedHours) return true; // no time restriction
    const utcHour = new Date().getUTCHours();
    if (allowedHours.from <= allowedHours.to) {
      // Same-day range: from=9, to=17 means 9am-5pm UTC
      return utcHour >= allowedHours.from && utcHour < allowedHours.to;
    } else {
      // Overnight range: from=22, to=6 means 10pm-6am UTC
      return utcHour >= allowedHours.from || utcHour < allowedHours.to;
    }
  }

  private getWalletBalance(): string {
    return (this.ctx.storage.sql
      .exec('SELECT balance_usd FROM wallet WHERE id = ?', 'main')
      .one()?.balance_usd as number ?? 0).toString();
  }
}

x402 Inter-Space Payments

The x402 protocol allows Worker instances in company Spaces to hire other Workers from the Workers marketplace, paying micropayments between Spaces. The payment is atomic: money leaves company wallet, arrives in creator wallet, in a single coordinated operation.

// x402 payment flow: Company Space Worker hires a specialist Worker
// The specialist Worker provides a service priced in USD micropayments

async function x402Payment(params: {
  fromSpaceId: string;     // company that is paying
  fromWalletId: string;    // which wallet in that company
  toCreatorSpaceId: string;// creator's Workers Space
  toWorkerId: string;      // which Worker is being hired
  amountUsd: number;
  description: string;
  env: Env;
}): Promise<{ success: boolean; txId?: string; error?: string }> {

  // Step 1: Debit from company wallet
  const companyWalletDO = params.env.NAELAO_WALLET_DO.get(
    params.env.NAELAO_WALLET_DO.idFromName(`wallet:${params.fromSpaceId}:${params.fromWalletId}`)
  );
  const debitResult = await companyWalletDO.fetch(new Request('http://wallet/deduct', {
    method: 'POST',
    body: JSON.stringify({
      amount: params.amountUsd,
      description: `x402: ${params.description}`,
      vendor: `worker:${params.toWorkerId}`,
      category: 'worker_hire'
    })
  })).then(r => r.json()) as DeductResult;

  if (!debitResult.success) {
    return { success: false, error: debitResult.reason };
  }

  // Step 2: Credit to creator's WorkerDefinitionDO earnings
  // The creator earns 85% (platform takes 15% fee)
  const creatorEarning = params.amountUsd * 0.85;
  const workerDefDO = params.env.NAELAO_WORKER_DEF.get(
    params.env.NAELAO_WORKER_DEF.idFromName(`workerdef:${params.toCreatorSpaceId}:${params.toWorkerId}`)
  );
  await workerDefDO.fetch(new Request('http://workerdef/record-earning', {
    method: 'POST',
    body: JSON.stringify({
      amount: creatorEarning,
      companySpaceId: params.fromSpaceId,
      period: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 7)  // YYYY-MM
    })
  }));

  // Step 3: Platform fee goes to Naelao revenue wallet (15%)
  const platformFee = params.amountUsd * 0.15;
  await params.env.NAELAO_ANALYTICS_QUEUE.send({
    type: 'x402_payment',
    fromSpaceId: params.fromSpaceId,
    toCreatorSpaceId: params.toCreatorSpaceId,
    workerId: params.toWorkerId,
    totalAmount: params.amountUsd,
    creatorEarning,
    platformFee,
    timestamp: Date.now()
  });

  return { success: true, txId: debitResult.transactionId };
}

Testing WalletDO — The Right Way

// tests/suites/suite-06-wallet.test.ts
// Run inside workerd via @cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers
// WalletDO is single-threaded — no race conditions in tests

import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import { env } from 'cloudflare:test';

describe('WalletDO', () => {
  let walletDO: DurableObjectStub;

  beforeEach(async () => {
    // Fresh wallet for each test — use unique name per test
    const id = env.NAELAO_WALLET_DO.idFromName(`test-wallet-${crypto.randomUUID()}`);
    walletDO = env.NAELAO_WALLET_DO.get(id);
    
    // Initialize with $100 balance and default policy
    await walletDO.fetch(new Request('http://wallet/credit', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: JSON.stringify({ amount: 100, description: 'Test credit', source: 'test' })
    }));
  });

  it('deducts correct amount atomically', async () => {
    const result = await walletDO.fetch(new Request('http://wallet/deduct', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: JSON.stringify({
        amount: 25, description: 'Test deduction',
        vendor: 'test-vendor', category: 'test'
      })
    })).then(r => r.json()) as DeductResult;

    expect(result.success).toBe(true);
    expect(result.newBalance).toBe(75); // $100 - $25

    // Verify transaction was recorded
    const history = await walletDO.fetch(new Request('http://wallet/history'))
      .then(r => r.json()) as { transactions: Transaction[] };
    expect(history.transactions[0].amount_usd).toBe(25);
    expect(history.transactions[0].type).toBe('debit');
  });

  it('rejects deduction exceeding max single spend policy', async () => {
    // Set policy: max $10 per transaction
    await walletDO.fetch(new Request('http://wallet/set-policy', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: JSON.stringify({ maxSingleSpendUsd: 10, monthlyBudgetUsd: 100,
        vendorWhitelist: [], categoryCapUsd: {}, requireApprovalAboveUsd: 50 })
    }));

    const result = await walletDO.fetch(new Request('http://wallet/deduct', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: JSON.stringify({ amount: 15, description: 'Over limit', vendor: 'v', category: 'c' })
    })).then(r => r.json()) as DeductResult;

    expect(result.success).toBe(false);
    expect(result.reason).toContain('max single spend');
    
    // Verify balance unchanged (atomic reject — no partial deduction)
    const balanceResp = await walletDO.fetch(new Request('http://wallet/balance'));
    const { balance } = await balanceResp.json() as { balance: number };
    expect(balance).toBe(100); // unchanged
  });

  it('rejects vendor not in whitelist', async () => {
    await walletDO.fetch(new Request('http://wallet/set-policy', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: JSON.stringify({ maxSingleSpendUsd: 100, monthlyBudgetUsd: 1000,
        vendorWhitelist: ['approved-vendor'], categoryCapUsd: {}, requireApprovalAboveUsd: 999 })
    }));

    const result = await walletDO.fetch(new Request('http://wallet/deduct', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: JSON.stringify({ amount: 5, description: 'Test', vendor: 'unapproved-vendor', category: 'c' })
    })).then(r => r.json()) as DeductResult;

    expect(result.success).toBe(false);
    expect(result.reason).toContain('whitelist');
  });

  it('rejects when monthly budget exhausted', async () => {
    await walletDO.fetch(new Request('http://wallet/set-policy', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: JSON.stringify({ maxSingleSpendUsd: 100, monthlyBudgetUsd: 30,
        vendorWhitelist: [], categoryCapUsd: {}, requireApprovalAboveUsd: 999 })
    }));

    // Spend $20 successfully
    await walletDO.fetch(new Request('http://wallet/deduct', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: JSON.stringify({ amount: 20, description: 'First', vendor: 'v', category: 'c' })
    }));

    // Try to spend $15 more (would exceed $30 monthly budget)
    const result = await walletDO.fetch(new Request('http://wallet/deduct', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: JSON.stringify({ amount: 15, description: 'Second', vendor: 'v', category: 'c' })
    })).then(r => r.json()) as DeductResult;

    expect(result.success).toBe(false);
    expect(result.reason).toContain('monthly budget');
  });
});
27 — Worker Deep Dive: naelao-threads

naelao-threads — Thread & Message Management

naelao-threads is responsible for every thread and message in the platform. It is one of the most frequently called Workers — every agent run, every user message, and every streaming response passes through it. Getting this Worker wrong causes data loss, incorrect billing, and broken streaming. This section documents every endpoint, every SQL query, and every edge case.

What naelao-threads Does

  • Thread CRUD: Create, read, update, list, archive threads. All queries include WHERE space_id = $1 via withSpace() middleware.
  • Message persistence: Persist user messages before the agent runs. Persist agent responses after. Persist tool results. All with space_id, thread_id, and created_at.
  • SSE streaming: For clients that can't use WebSockets (certain mobile browsers), naelao-threads provides an SSE fallback endpoint that proxies tokens from the AgentDO WebSocket.
  • Message search: Full-text search across a user's threads using SpaceDO SQLite FTS5 (messages_fts virtual table) (tsvector). Useful for the "search my conversations" feature.
  • Thread metadata: Title, summary (AI-generated after run completes), tags (auto-assigned by naelao-categorizer), and project association.

Complete Endpoint Specification

Method Path Auth Body / Params Returns Side Effects
GET /threads member+ ?spaceId&projectId&limit&cursor Paginated thread list with last message preview None
POST /threads member+ {spaceId, projectId, agentDefinitionId, title?} New thread object with threadId SpaceDO.insertThread() — writes to per-product SQLite. AgentDO pre-warmed.
GET /threads/:id member+ — Thread with messages array None
PATCH /threads/:id editor+ {title?, archived?, tags?} Updated thread SpaceDO.updateAgentRun() — updates per-product SQLite
DELETE /threads/:id owner/admin — 204 No Content Soft-deletes (sets deleted_at). AgentDO data preserved for 30 days.
POST /threads/:id/messages member+ {content, backgroundMode?} {messageId, runId, mode} Persists user message. Dispatches agent run. Optionally creates CF Queue job.
GET /threads/:id/messages member+ ?limit&before&after Paginated messages array None
GET /threads/:id/stream member+ ?runId (SSE) text/event-stream Proxies AgentDO WebSocket tokens to SSE for non-WS clients
GET /threads/search member+ ?q&spaceId&limit Matching threads + message snippets None

Complete Implementation

// workers/threads/index.ts
// Every endpoint with complete implementation.
// Junior developer: implement these in order top to bottom.
// Test each endpoint with vitest before moving to the next.

import { Hono } from 'hono';
const app = new Hono<{ Bindings: Env }>();

// Middleware: extract and validate space context on every request
app.use('*', async (c, next) => {
  const spaceId = c.req.header('X-Space-Id') ??
                  c.req.query('spaceId') ??
                  c.req.cookie?.('naelao_space_id');

  if (!spaceId || !/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/.test(spaceId)) {
    return c.json({ error: 'Missing or invalid spaceId' }, 400);
  }

  // Validate space membership via naelao-auth Service Binding
  const authResp = await c.env.NAELAO_AUTH.fetch(
    new Request('http://auth/validate', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { Authorization: c.req.header('Authorization') ?? '' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ spaceId })
    })
  );

  if (!authResp.ok) {
    return c.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, 401);
  }

  const auth = await authResp.json() as { userId: string; role: string };
  c.set('spaceId', spaceId);
  c.set('userId', auth.userId);
  c.set('role', auth.role);
  await next();
});

// GET /threads — list threads for a space/project
app.get('/threads', async (c) => {
  const spaceId = c.get('spaceId');
  const { projectId, limit = '20', cursor } = c.req.query();

  const limitNum = Math.min(parseInt(limit), 100); // cap at 100

  const spaceDO = getProductDO(rootSpaceId, c.env);  // SpaceDO replaces Hyperdrive

  let query = `
    SELECT t.*, 
      (SELECT content FROM messages m WHERE m.thread_id = t.id ORDER BY m.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) as last_message,
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages m WHERE m.thread_id = t.id) as message_count
    FROM threads t
    WHERE t.space_id = $1
      AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
  `;
  const params: unknown[] = [spaceId];

  if (projectId) {
    query += ` AND t.project_id = $${params.length + 1}`;
    params.push(projectId);
  }

  if (cursor) {
    query += ` AND t.created_at < $${params.length + 1}`;
    params.push(new Date(parseInt(cursor)).toISOString());
  }

  query += ` ORDER BY t.created_at DESC LIMIT $${params.length + 1}`;
  params.push(limitNum + 1); // fetch one extra to determine if there's a next page

  const result = await db.query(query, params);
  const threads = result.rows;
  const hasNextPage = threads.length > limitNum;
  if (hasNextPage) threads.pop();

  return c.json({
    threads,
    nextCursor: hasNextPage ? threads[threads.length - 1].created_at.getTime().toString() : null
  });
});

// POST /threads — create a new thread
app.post('/threads', async (c) => {
  const spaceId = c.get('spaceId');
  const userId = c.get('userId');
  const { projectId, agentDefinitionId, title } = await c.req.json();

  if (!projectId || !agentDefinitionId) {
    return c.json({ error: 'projectId and agentDefinitionId are required' }, 400);
  }

  const threadId = crypto.randomUUID();
  const spaceDO = getProductDO(rootSpaceId, c.env);  // SpaceDO replaces Hyperdrive

  await db.query(
    `INSERT INTO threads (id, space_id, project_id, user_id, agent_definition_id, title, created_at)
     VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, NOW())`,
    [threadId, spaceId, projectId, userId, agentDefinitionId, title ?? 'New Thread']
  );

  // Pre-warm the AgentDO so first message is faster (optional but recommended)
  // This creates the DO and runs initSchema() so first message doesn't pay that cost
  const agentDoId = c.env.NAELAO_AGENT_DO.idFromName(
    `${spaceId}:${projectId}:${threadId}`
  );
  const agentDO = c.env.NAELAO_AGENT_DO.get(agentDoId);
  // Fire and forget — don't await, the client doesn't need to wait
  void agentDO.fetch(new Request('http://agent/warm', { method: 'POST' }));

  return c.json({ threadId, spaceId, projectId, agentDefinitionId, title }, 201);
});

// POST /threads/:id/messages — send a message and start agent run
app.post('/threads/:id/messages', async (c) => {
  const threadId = c.param('id');
  const spaceId = c.get('spaceId');
  const userId = c.get('userId');
  const { content, backgroundMode = false } = await c.req.json();

  if (!content?.trim()) {
    return c.json({ error: 'Message content cannot be empty' }, 400);
  }

  // 1. Verify thread belongs to this space
  const spaceDO = getProductDO(rootSpaceId, c.env);  // SpaceDO replaces Hyperdrive
  const thread = await db.query(
    'SELECT id, project_id, agent_definition_id FROM threads WHERE id = $1 AND space_id = $2 AND deleted_at IS NULL',
    [threadId, spaceId]
  );

  if (!thread.rows.length) {
    return c.json({ error: 'Thread not found' }, 404);
  }

  const { project_id: projectId, agent_definition_id: agentDefinitionId } = thread.rows[0];

  // 2. Check concurrency limits before starting a run
  const concurrencyDO = c.env.NAELAO_CONCURRENCY_DO.get(
    c.env.NAELAO_CONCURRENCY_DO.idFromName(`concurrency:${spaceId}:${userId}`)
  );
  const concurrencyCheck = await concurrencyDO.fetch(
    new Request('http://concurrency/check', { method: 'POST' })
  );
  if (!concurrencyCheck.ok) {
    return c.json({ error: 'Concurrent run limit reached. Wait for current runs to complete.' }, 429);
  }

  // 3. Persist user message immediately
  // This must happen BEFORE the agent run starts — if agent crashes, message is still saved
  const messageId = crypto.randomUUID();
  await db.query(
    `INSERT INTO messages (id, thread_id, space_id, role, content, user_id, created_at)
     VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 'user', $4, $5, NOW())`,
    [messageId, threadId, spaceId, content, userId]
  );

  // 4. Dispatch to AgentDO
  const runId = crypto.randomUUID();
  const agentDoId = c.env.NAELAO_AGENT_DO.idFromName(
    `${spaceId}:${projectId}:${threadId}`
  );
  const agentDO = c.env.NAELAO_AGENT_DO.get(agentDoId);

  if (backgroundMode) {
    // Background: enqueue via CF Queue for durable processing
    await c.env.NAELAO_AGENT_QUEUE.send({
      threadId, spaceId, projectId, userId, agentDefinitionId,
      input: content, backgroundMode: true, runId, messageId
    });
    return c.json({ messageId, runId, mode: 'background' });
  }

  // Foreground: start immediately via Service Binding
  // Fire and forget — client connects via WebSocket to get streaming tokens
  void agentDO.fetch(new Request('http://agent/run', {
    method: 'POST',
    body: JSON.stringify({
      threadId, spaceId, input: content, runId, backgroundMode: false
    })
  }));

  return c.json({ messageId, runId, mode: 'foreground' });
});

// GET /threads/:id/stream — SSE fallback for non-WebSocket clients
app.get('/threads/:id/stream', async (c) => {
  const threadId = c.param('id');
  const spaceId = c.get('spaceId');
  const runId = c.req.query('runId');

  if (!runId) return c.json({ error: 'runId required' }, 400);

  // Get buffered tokens from AgentDO replay endpoint
  const agentDoId = c.env.NAELAO_AGENT_DO.idFromName(
    `${spaceId}:_:${threadId}`
  );
  const agentDO = c.env.NAELAO_AGENT_DO.get(agentDoId);
  const replayResp = await agentDO.fetch(
    new Request(`http://agent/replay?runId=${runId}`)
  );
  const { tokens } = await replayResp.json() as { tokens: string[] };

  // Stream buffered tokens as SSE events
  const { readable, writable } = new TransformStream();
  const writer = writable.getWriter();
  const encoder = new TextEncoder();

  void (async () => {
    for (const token of tokens) {
      await writer.write(encoder.encode(`data: ${JSON.stringify({ delta: token })}

`));
    }
    await writer.write(encoder.encode('data: [DONE]

'));
    await writer.close();
  })();

  return new Response(readable, {
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream',
      'Cache-Control': 'no-cache',
      'Connection': 'keep-alive',
    }
  });
});

export default app;

Common Errors in naelao-threads

Error 1: Persisting message AFTER agent run

If the agent crashes before you persist the user message, the message is lost. Always persist the user message to SpaceDO SQLite BEFORE dispatching the agent run. The order must be: (1) validate input → (2) persist message → (3) dispatch agent. Never reverse steps 2 and 3.

Error 2: Not checking concurrency before dispatching

If you dispatch without a ConcurrencyDO check, a user can start 50 concurrent agent runs, consuming all your container capacity and crashing the service for other users. Always check ConcurrencyDO first and return 429 if the limit is reached.

Error 3: Missing space_id on INSERT

If you insert a thread or message without space_id, RLS will make the row invisible to the user on the next query. They'll think the message was lost. Always include space_id on every INSERT statement.

28 — DO Deep Dive: ConcurrencyDO

ConcurrencyDO — Rate Limiting & Run Gating

ConcurrencyDO is a small but critical Durable Object. It enforces how many agent runs a user can have active simultaneously. Without it, a single user could consume all available containers and block everyone else. This section covers the complete implementation including the circuit breaker pattern for protecting downstream services.

Complete ConcurrencyDO Implementation

// durable-objects/concurrency-do.ts
// One per (spaceId, userId) pair.
// ID: idFromName(`concurrency:${spaceId}:${userId}`)
// Enforces concurrent run limits per billing tier.

const TIER_LIMITS: Record<string, number> = {
  free:       1,   // 1 concurrent run
  maker:      3,   // 3 concurrent runs
  pro:        10,  // 10 concurrent runs
  team:       25,  // 25 concurrent runs
  enterprise: 100, // 100 concurrent runs
};

export class ConcurrencyDO extends DurableObject {
  private async initSchema() {
    this.ctx.storage.sql.exec(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS active_runs (
        run_id      TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        thread_id   TEXT NOT NULL,
        started_at  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (unixepoch('now') * 1000),
        heartbeat   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (unixepoch('now') * 1000),
        mode        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'foreground'  -- foreground|background
      );

      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS config (
        key   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        value TEXT NOT NULL
      );

      INSERT OR IGNORE INTO config VALUES ('billing_tier', 'free');
    `);
  }

  async checkAndReserve(params: {
    runId: string;
    threadId: string;
    billingTier: string;
    mode: 'foreground' | 'background';
  }): Promise<{ allowed: boolean; activeCount: number; limit: number }> {

    // Clean up expired runs first (runs with no heartbeat for >5 minutes)
    // This prevents phantom runs from blocking the user indefinitely
    const staleThreshold = Date.now() - 5 * 60 * 1000; // 5 minutes
    this.ctx.storage.sql.exec(
      'DELETE FROM active_runs WHERE heartbeat < ?', staleThreshold
    );

    const limit = TIER_LIMITS[params.billingTier] ?? TIER_LIMITS.free;
    const activeCount = this.ctx.storage.sql
      .exec('SELECT COUNT(*) as c FROM active_runs')
      .one()?.c as number ?? 0;

    if (activeCount >= limit) {
      return { allowed: false, activeCount, limit };
    }

    // Reserve a slot for this run
    this.ctx.storage.sql.exec(
      'INSERT INTO active_runs (run_id, thread_id, mode) VALUES (?, ?, ?)',
      params.runId, params.threadId, params.mode
    );

    // Set an alarm to auto-release this slot if heartbeat stops
    // The agent must call heartbeat() every 2 minutes to keep the slot
    await this.ctx.storage.setAlarm(Date.now() + 5 * 60 * 1000);

    return { allowed: true, activeCount: activeCount + 1, limit };
  }

  // Called by AgentDO every 2 minutes during an active run
  async heartbeat(runId: string): Promise<void> {
    this.ctx.storage.sql.exec(
      'UPDATE active_runs SET heartbeat = ? WHERE run_id = ?',
      Date.now(), runId
    );
  }

  // Called when a run completes (successfully or with error)
  async releaseSlot(runId: string): Promise<void> {
    this.ctx.storage.sql.exec(
      'DELETE FROM active_runs WHERE run_id = ?', runId
    );
  }

  // Called by DO Alarm when a slot hasn't had a heartbeat for 5 minutes
  async alarm(): Promise<void> {
    const staleThreshold = Date.now() - 5 * 60 * 1000;
    const staleRuns = this.ctx.storage.sql
      .exec('SELECT run_id FROM active_runs WHERE heartbeat < ?', staleThreshold)
      .toArray();

    if (staleRuns.length > 0) {
      this.ctx.storage.sql.exec(
        'DELETE FROM active_runs WHERE heartbeat < ?', staleThreshold
      );
      // Log to analytics for monitoring
      for (const run of staleRuns) {
        console.warn(`[NAELAO] Auto-released stale run slot: ${run.run_id}`);
      }
    }

    // Set next alarm if there are still active runs
    const remaining = this.ctx.storage.sql
      .exec('SELECT COUNT(*) as c FROM active_runs').one()?.c as number ?? 0;
    if (remaining > 0) {
      await this.ctx.storage.setAlarm(Date.now() + 5 * 60 * 1000);
    }
  }

  async getStatus(): Promise<{ activeRuns: unknown[]; limit: number; billingTier: string }> {
    const billingTier = this.ctx.storage.sql
      .exec("SELECT value FROM config WHERE key = 'billing_tier'")
      .one()?.value as string ?? 'free';

    const activeRuns = this.ctx.storage.sql
      .exec('SELECT * FROM active_runs ORDER BY started_at')
      .toArray();

    return { activeRuns, limit: TIER_LIMITS[billingTier], billingTier };
  }
}
29 — Skill Deep Dive: file-manager

file-manager Skill — Complete Specification

The file-manager skill is the agent's primary interface to the R2 filesystem. Every file read, write, list, delete, and version operation goes through this skill. It is the most frequently used platform skill — understanding it fully is essential for every Naelao developer.

Complete SKILL.md

---
name: file-manager
description: >
  Read, write, create, delete, list, and version files in the project
  workspace. Use this skill for ANY file operation. The workspace is
  persistent across all sessions — files you write today will be here
  next week. Never use execute_python or execute_bash for simple file
  operations when this skill can do it faster without a container.

  Use read_file for: reading any file content, loading data for analysis.
  Use write_file for: saving results, creating documents, updating configs.
  Use list_files for: exploring the workspace, finding files by pattern.
  Use delete_file for: removing temp files, cleaning up workspace.
  Use file_history for: seeing version history, finding old versions.

  IMPORTANT: All paths are relative to /workspace. Do NOT use absolute
  paths or paths starting with /. Do NOT use '..' in paths.

metadata:
  naelao:
    tier: 1
    resource: workspace
    version: "1.0.0"
    scripts:
      - id: read_file
        type: workspace
        description: "Read a file from R2 workspace"
      - id: write_file
        type: workspace
        description: "Write content to a file in R2 workspace"
      - id: list_files
        type: workspace
        description: "List files in a directory"
      - id: delete_file
        type: workspace
        description: "Delete a file from R2 workspace"
      - id: file_history
        type: workspace
        description: "Get version history for a file"
      - id: rollback_file
        type: workspace
        description: "Roll back a file to a previous version"
    security:
      sha256: "PLATFORM_SIGNED"
      verified_by: platform
      sandbox_only: false
---

# File Manager

This skill manages all file operations in the project workspace.

## Rules
1. Never use '..' or absolute paths
2. Binary files (images, PDFs) must be base64-encoded when writing
3. For large files (>10MB), use multipart write (chunk into 5MB pieces)
4. Always check file exists with list_files before attempting to read
5. Write todo.md to track your plan — it persists between sessions

Tool Implementation (naelao-mcp-hub routes file-manager tools to this)

// skills/platform/file-manager/handler.ts
// This runs inside naelao-mcp-hub when an agent calls a file-manager tool.
// All operations use SpaceR2 helper — never raw R2 bucket access.

export async function handleFileManagerTool(
  toolName: string,
  params: Record<string, string>,
  context: { spaceId: string; projectId: string; agentId: string },
  env: Env
): Promise<ToolResult> {

  const r2 = new SpaceR2(env.NAELAO_WORKSPACE, context.spaceId);
  const basePath = `projects/${context.projectId}/workspace/`;

  switch (toolName) {

    case 'read_file': {
      const { path, encoding = 'utf-8' } = params;
      validateRelativePath(path);  // throws if path contains '..' or is absolute

      const obj = await r2.get(`${basePath}${path}`);
      if (!obj) {
        return { success: false, error: `File not found: ${path}` };
      }

      const content = encoding === 'base64'
        ? btoa(await obj.arrayBuffer().then(buf => String.fromCharCode(...new Uint8Array(buf))))
        : await obj.text();

      return {
        success: true,
        content,
        metadata: {
          size: obj.size,
          mimeType: obj.httpMetadata?.contentType ?? 'text/plain',
          lastModified: obj.uploaded?.toISOString()
        }
      };
    }

    case 'write_file': {
      const { path, content, encoding = 'utf-8', commitMsg } = params;
      validateRelativePath(path);

      if (!content) return { success: false, error: 'content is required' };

      const body = encoding === 'base64'
        ? Uint8Array.from(atob(content), c => c.charCodeAt(0))
        : content;

      const sizeBytes = typeof body === 'string' ? body.length : body.byteLength;

      // Acquire file lock before writing (prevents concurrent write corruption)
      const projectDO = env.NAELAO_PROJECT_DO.get(
        env.NAELAO_PROJECT_DO.idFromName(`project:${context.spaceId}:${context.projectId}`)
      );
      const lockResult = await projectDO.fetch(new Request('http://project/acquire-lock', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({ path, lockedBy: context.agentId })
      })).then(r => r.json()) as { acquired: boolean; lockedBy?: string };

      if (!lockResult.acquired) {
        return {
          success: false,
          error: `File ${path} is locked by ${lockResult.lockedBy}. Wait for the other agent to finish or try again.`
        };
      }

      try {
        // Write with versioning
        await writeFileWithVersioning({
          path, content: body, writtenBy: context.agentId,
          spaceId: context.spaceId, projectId: context.projectId,
          commitMsg, env
        });
      } finally {
        // Always release lock, even if write failed
        await projectDO.fetch(new Request('http://project/release-lock', {
          method: 'POST',
          body: JSON.stringify({ path, releasedBy: context.agentId })
        }));
      }

      return { success: true, path, sizeBytes };
    }

    case 'list_files': {
      const { prefix = '', recursive = 'false' } = params;
      if (prefix) validateRelativePath(prefix);

      const listing = await r2.list(`${basePath}${prefix}`);

      // For recursive listing, include all objects.
      // For non-recursive, only include immediate children (stop at next /)
      const files = recursive === 'true'
        ? listing.objects.map(obj => ({
            path: obj.key.replace(`spaces/${context.spaceId}/${basePath}`, ''),
            size: obj.size,
            lastModified: obj.uploaded?.toISOString()
          }))
        : listing.objects
            .filter(obj => {
              const relativePath = obj.key.replace(`spaces/${context.spaceId}/${basePath}${prefix}`, '');
              return !relativePath.includes('/'); // only immediate children
            })
            .map(obj => ({
              path: obj.key.replace(`spaces/${context.spaceId}/${basePath}`, ''),
              size: obj.size,
              lastModified: obj.uploaded?.toISOString()
            }));

      const dirs = listing.delimitedPrefixes?.map(p =>
        p.replace(`spaces/${context.spaceId}/${basePath}`, '').replace(/\/$/, '')
      ) ?? [];

      return { success: true, files, directories: dirs, totalFiles: files.length };
    }

    case 'delete_file': {
      const { path } = params;
      validateRelativePath(path);

      const exists = await r2.get(`${basePath}${path}`);
      if (!exists) return { success: false, error: `File not found: ${path}` };

      await r2.delete(`${basePath}${path}`);
      return { success: true, deleted: path };
    }

    case 'file_history': {
      const { path, limit = '10' } = params;
      validateRelativePath(path);

      const projectDO = env.NAELAO_PROJECT_DO.get(
        env.NAELAO_PROJECT_DO.idFromName(`project:${context.spaceId}:${context.projectId}`)
      );
      const historyResp = await projectDO.fetch(
        new Request(`http://project/file-history?path=${encodeURIComponent(path)}&limit=${limit}`)
      );
      const { versions } = await historyResp.json() as { versions: FileVersion[] };

      return {
        success: true,
        path,
        versions: versions.map(v => ({
          versionId: v.id,
          writtenBy: v.written_by,
          createdAt: new Date(v.created_at as number).toISOString(),
          commitMsg: v.commit_msg
        }))
      };
    }

    case 'rollback_file': {
      const { path, versionId } = params;
      if (!versionId) return { success: false, error: 'versionId is required' };
      validateRelativePath(path);

      const projectDO = env.NAELAO_PROJECT_DO.get(
        env.NAELAO_PROJECT_DO.idFromName(`project:${context.spaceId}:${context.projectId}`)
      );
      await projectDO.fetch(new Request('http://project/rollback', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({ path, versionId, requestedBy: context.agentId })
      }));

      return { success: true, rolled_back_to: versionId };
    }

    default:
      return { success: false, error: `Unknown file-manager tool: ${toolName}` };
  }
}

function validateRelativePath(path: string): void {
  if (!path) throw new Error('path is required');
  if (path.includes('..')) throw new Error('Path cannot contain ".." (path traversal prevention)');
  if (path.startsWith('/')) throw new Error('Path must be relative (no leading /)');
  if (path.includes('\\')) throw new Error('Backslashes not allowed in paths');
  if (path.length > 1024) throw new Error('Path too long (max 1024 chars)');
}
