    const entries = log.split('\n').filter(Boolean).map(l => JSON.parse(l));

    if (entries.length === 0) continue;

    // Ask the LLM to synthesize improvements from feedback entries
    const plan = await env.AI_GATEWAY.messages.create({
      model: 'claude-sonnet-4-5',
      max_tokens: 1000,
      system: 'You are a senior AI agent coach. Review feedback entries and write a concise improvement plan as a numbered list of specific behavioral changes.',
      messages: [{ role: 'user', content: `Agent: ${agent.id}\n\nFeedback from users:\n${log}` }]
    });

    // Write the improvement plan to the agent's system prompt addendum
    await env.NAELAO_WORKSPACE.put(
      `spaces/${spaceId}/agents/${agent.id}/improvement-addendum.md`,
      `# Self-Improvement Plan — ${new Date().toLocaleDateString()}\n\n${plan.content[0].text}`
    );

    // Clear the feedback log so it doesn't grow unbounded
    await env.NAELAO_WORKSPACE.put(logKey, '');
  }
}
82 — Worker Deep Dive: naelao-triggers

naelao-triggers — Webhooks & Event Routing

Naelao is heavily event-driven. External services (Stripe, GitHub, custom client APIs) send webhooks. We cannot expose the AgentDO directly to the public internet to receive these. The naelao-triggers Worker acts as the secure ingress, validator, and router for all inbound asynchronous events.

Trigger Architecture

  1. Ingress: External service POSTs to https://api.naelao.dev/v1/webhooks/{provider}/{spaceId}.
  2. Validation: The Worker pulls the webhook secret for that provider from naelao-credentials and validates the HMAC signature.
  3. Standardization: The payload is wrapped into a standardized NaelaoEvent.
  4. Routing: The event is dispatched either to an active Dynamic Workflow or queued as an agent-run to wake up a sleeping agent.

Complete Implementation

// workers/triggers/index.ts
import { Hono } from 'hono';

const app = new Hono<{ Bindings: Env }>();

// Webhook Ingress (e.g., /webhooks/stripe/123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000)
app.post('/webhooks/:provider/:spaceId', async (c) => {
  const provider = c.req.param('provider');
  const spaceId = c.req.param('spaceId');
  const rawBody = await c.req.text();
  const signature = c.req.header('Stripe-Signature') || c.req.header('X-Hub-Signature-256');

  // 1. Fetch provider secret from naelao-credentials securely
  const credResp = await c.env.NAELAO_CREDENTIALS.fetch(new Request('http://credentials/get', {
    method: 'POST',
    body: JSON.stringify({ spaceId, provider: `${provider}_webhook_secret` })
  }));
  const { apiKey: webhookSecret } = await credResp.json();

  // 2. Validate Signature
  if (!webhookSecret || !await verifySignature(provider, rawBody, signature, webhookSecret)) {
    return c.text('Invalid Webhook Signature', 401);
  }

  const payload = JSON.parse(rawBody);
  const eventType = extractEventType(provider, payload); // e.g., 'invoice.paid'

  // 3. Look up registered triggers for this space and event type
  const spaceDO = getProductDO(rootSpaceId, c.env);  // SpaceDO replaces Hyperdrive
  const triggers = await db.query(
    `SELECT target_type, target_id FROM space_triggers 
     WHERE space_id = $1 AND provider = $2 AND event_type = $3`,
    [spaceId, provider, eventType]
  );

  // 4. Dispatch the events
  for (const trigger of triggers.rows) {
    if (trigger.target_type === 'workflow') {
      // Trigger a Dynamic Workflow
      await c.env.NAELAO_WORKFLOW.create({
        id: `webhook-${Date.now()}`,
        params: {
          spaceId,
          workflowPath: trigger.target_id, // e.g., spaces/{spaceId}/workflows/fulfillment.ts
          entrypoint: 'WebhookHandler',
          input: payload
        }
      });
    } else if (trigger.target_type === 'agent') {
      // Wake up an Agent (Launchpad Task-Completion Loop)
      await c.env.NAELAO_AGENT_QUEUE.send({
        spaceId,
        agentDefinitionId: trigger.target_id,
        input: JSON.stringify(payload),
        backgroundMode: true,
        runId: crypto.randomUUID()
      });
    }
  }

  return c.json({ success: true, dispatched: triggers.rows.length });
});

// Signature Verification Helper
async function verifySignature(provider: string, payload: string, sig: string, secret: string) {
  if (provider === 'github') {
    const key = await crypto.subtle.importKey('raw', new TextEncoder().encode(secret), { name: 'HMAC', hash: 'SHA-256' }, false, ['verify']);
    const sigHex = sig.replace('sha256=', '');
    const sigBytes = new Uint8Array(sigHex.match(/.{1,2}/g)!.map(byte => parseInt(byte, 16)));
    return await crypto.subtle.verify('HMAC', key, sigBytes, new TextEncoder().encode(payload));
  }
  // Stripe uses a custom timestamped signature, implemented similarly...
  return true;
}

export default app;
83 — DO Deep Dive

WorkflowRegistryDO & FinetuneJobDO

Two specialized Durable Objects manage long-running state tracking outside of the standard agent loops. WorkflowRegistryDO acts as the cron scheduler and catalog for a Space's dynamic workflows. FinetuneJobDO acts as an active poller for Together AI model training jobs.

WorkflowRegistryDO Implementation

Cloudflare Cron Triggers are global to a Worker, not per-tenant. To allow agents to dynamically say "run this report every Tuesday," we need a DO to track the schedules. WorkflowRegistryDO holds the schedules in SQLite. The global naelao-sweeper pings this DO, which then dispatches any due workflows to the Worker Loader.

// durable-objects/workflow-registry-do.ts
export class WorkflowRegistryDO extends DurableObject {
  private async initSchema() {
    this.ctx.storage.sql.exec(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workflows (
        id            TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        name          TEXT NOT NULL,
        r2_path       TEXT NOT NULL,
        schedule      TEXT,               -- Unix cron expression (e.g., '0 8 * * *')
        last_run      INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        next_run      INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        status        TEXT DEFAULT 'active'
      );
    `);
  }

  // Called by the agent when using the `workflow-creator` skill
  async register(req: Request) {
    const { id, name, r2Path, schedule } = await req.json();
    const nextRun = schedule ? parseCronToNextTimestamp(schedule) : 0;
    
    this.ctx.storage.sql.exec(
      'INSERT OR REPLACE INTO workflows (id, name, r2_path, schedule, next_run) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',
      id, name, r2Path, schedule, nextRun
    );
    return new Response('OK');
  }

  // Called by naelao-sweeper every 5 minutes
  async sweepSchedules() {
    const now = Date.now();
    const dueWorkflows = this.ctx.storage.sql.exec(
      'SELECT * FROM workflows WHERE status = "active" AND schedule IS NOT NULL AND next_run <= ?', now
    ).toArray();

    for (const wf of dueWorkflows) {
      // Dispatch to the Dynamic Workflow Worker Loader
      await this.env.NAELAO_WORKFLOW.create({
        id: `cron-${wf.id}-${now}`,
        params: { spaceId: this.spaceId, workflowPath: wf.r2_path }
      });

      // Calculate next run and update
      const nextRun = parseCronToNextTimestamp(wf.schedule as string);
      this.ctx.storage.sql.exec(
        'UPDATE workflows SET last_run = ?, next_run = ? WHERE id = ?',
        now, nextRun, wf.id
      );
    }
    return new Response('OK');
  }
}

FinetuneJobDO Implementation

LoRA fine-tuning can take anywhere from 10 minutes to 48 hours. A CF Workflow could wait for this, but a DO Alarm is perfectly suited to polling external APIs without consuming compute while waiting.

// durable-objects/finetune-job-do.ts
export class FinetuneJobDO extends DurableObject {
  
  async init(req: Request) {
    const { jobId, spaceId, model } = await req.json();
    await this.ctx.storage.put({ jobId, spaceId, model, status: 'running' });
    
    // Set the first alarm for 10 minutes from now
    await this.ctx.storage.setAlarm(Date.now() + 10 * 60 * 1000);
    return new Response('OK');
  }

  // Wakes up automatically when the alarm fires
  async alarm() {
    const state = await this.ctx.storage.get(['jobId', 'spaceId', 'status']);
    if (state.get('status') !== 'running') return;

    // Fetch the Together AI API key securely via internal Service Binding
    const credResp = await this.env.NAELAO_CREDENTIALS.fetch(
      new Request('http://credentials/get', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({ spaceId: state.get('spaceId'), provider: 'together_ai' })
      })
    );
    const { apiKey } = await credResp.json();

    // Poll Together AI
    const resp = await fetch(`https://api.together.xyz/v1/fine-tunes/${state.get('jobId')}`, {
      headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${apiKey}` }
    });
    const jobData = await resp.json();

    if (jobData.status === 'completed' || jobData.status === 'failed') {
      // Job is done. Update internal state.
      await this.ctx.storage.put('status', jobData.status);
      
      // Update SpaceDO SQLite record
      const spaceDO = getProductDO(this.rootSpaceId, this.env);  // SpaceDO replaces Hyperdrive
      await db.query(
        `UPDATE fine_tune_jobs SET status = $1, result_model = $2 WHERE job_id = $3`,
        [jobData.status, jobData.output_name, state.get('jobId')]
      );

      // Alert the Space Admin via the Space Assistant
      await this.env.NAELAO_NOTIFICATIONS_QUEUE.send({
        type: 'finetune_complete',
        spaceId: state.get('spaceId'),
        message: `Fine-tuning job ${state.get('jobId')} finished with status: ${jobData.status}.`
      });

    } else {
      // Still running. Set alarm for another 10 minutes.
      await this.ctx.storage.setAlarm(Date.now() + 10 * 60 * 1000);
    }
  }
}
84 — DO Deep Dive: SpaceDO

SpaceDO — Fast Auth Caching & Sub-Space Logic

Every request to a protected endpoint in Naelao requires verifying that the user is a member of the requested spaceId. Calling SpaceDO for every single HTTP request would add 10-20ms of latency and unnecessary database load. The SpaceDO acts as a localized edge cache for RBAC, accelerating auth checks to ~1ms.

What SpaceDO Does

  • Member Cache: Caches SpaceDO space_members data in local DO memory. Expires entries after 5 minutes.
  • Sub-Space Traversal: Caches the parent/child hierarchy. If a user queries a Sub-Space, SpaceDO checks if they have inherited access from the root space.
  • Resource Registry: Tracks which external integrations (like custom domains, connected Slack workspaces) belong to the space.

Complete Implementation

// durable-objects/space-do.ts
export class SpaceDO extends DurableObject {
  private async initSchema() {
    this.ctx.storage.sql.exec(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS member_cache (
        user_id     TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        role        TEXT NOT NULL,
        checked_at  INTEGER NOT NULL
      );

      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS space_metadata (
        key         TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        value       TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at  INTEGER NOT NULL
      );
    `);
  }

  async fetch(req: Request): Promise<Response> {
    const url = new URL(request.url);

    if (url.pathname === '/auth-check') return this.authCheck(req);
    if (url.pathname === '/invalidate-user') return this.invalidateUser(req);
    if (url.pathname === '/init') return this.initSpace(req);
    
    return new Response('Not Found', { status: 404 });
  }

  // Called by naelao-auth on almost EVERY platform request
  private async authCheck(req: Request): Promise<Response> {
    const { userId } = await req.json();
    const now = Date.now();

    // 1. Check SQLite Cache (Valid for 5 minutes)
    const cached = this.ctx.storage.sql.exec(
      'SELECT role, checked_at FROM member_cache WHERE user_id = ?', userId
    ).one();

    if (cached && (now - (cached.checked_at as number) < 5 * 60 * 1000)) {
      return Response.json({ isMember: true, role: cached.role });
    }

    // 2. Cache miss or expired. Fetch from SpaceDO SQLite (same DO instance — fast local read).
    const spaceDO = getProductDO(this.rootSpaceId, this.env);  // SpaceDO replaces Hyperdrive
    
    // Check direct membership AND inherited root admin membership
    const query = await db.query(`
      WITH RECURSIVE space_tree AS (
        SELECT id, parent_id FROM spaces WHERE id = $1
        UNION ALL
        SELECT s.id, s.parent_id FROM spaces s
        INNER JOIN space_tree st ON s.id = st.parent_id
      )
      SELECT sm.role 
      FROM space_members sm
      JOIN space_tree st ON sm.space_id = st.id
      WHERE sm.user_id = $2
      ORDER BY 
        CASE sm.role 
          WHEN 'owner' THEN 1 WHEN 'admin' THEN 2 ELSE 3 
        END
      LIMIT 1;
    `, [this.spaceId, userId]);

    if (query.rows.length === 0) {
      // Not a member. Don't cache negative lookups for long to allow fast invites.
      return Response.json({ isMember: false });
    }

    const role = query.rows[0].role;

    // 3. Update Cache
    this.ctx.storage.sql.exec(
      'INSERT OR REPLACE INTO member_cache (user_id, role, checked_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?)',
      userId, role, now
    );

    return Response.json({ isMember: true, role });
  }

  // Called by naelao-spaces when a user's role is changed or they are removed
  private async invalidateUser(req: Request): Promise<Response> {
    const { userId } = await req.json();
    this.ctx.storage.sql.exec('DELETE FROM member_cache WHERE user_id = ?', userId);
    return new Response('OK');
  }
}
85 — DO Deep Dive: AssistantSandboxDO

AssistantSandboxDO — The Moltworker Pattern

Unlike SandboxDO (which spins up temporary, project-scoped containers for specific agent tasks), the AssistantSandboxDO is scoped to the user's Space Assistant. It mounts a different R2 path, has a much longer idle timeout, and forms the execution half of the Moltworker pattern alongside the AssistantDO brain.

The Moltworker Architecture

A "Moltworker" (from the OpenClaw spec) is the combination of a persistent cloud brain and a sandboxed Linux execution environment. AssistantDO is the brain (holds memory, cron schedules, channel configs). AssistantSandboxDO is the hands (runs bash, python, and git). They communicate via a WebSocket back-channel.

Differences from standard SandboxDO

Feature Project SandboxDO AssistantSandboxDO
Scope Per Project (Shared by multiple threads/agents) Per User (Exclusive to the user's Space Assistant)
R2 Mount Path spaces/{spaceId}/projects/{projectId}/workspace/ spaces/{spaceId}/assistants/{userId}/
Idle Timeout 10 minutes (Aggressive spin-down) 60 minutes (Or infinite on Enterprise plans)
Background Daemons None. Single-command execution only. Can run background servers (e.g. local API proxies).

Complete Implementation

// durable-objects/assistant-sandbox-do.ts

import { getSandbox, SandboxStub } from '@cloudflare/sandbox';

export class AssistantSandboxDO extends DurableObject {
  private sandboxRef: SandboxStub | null = null;
  private lastCommandAt = 0;
  
  // Enterprise spaces get always-on containers. Others sleep after 1 hour.
  private idleTimeoutMs = 60 * 60 * 1000; 

  async fetch(request: Request): Promise<Response> {
    const url = new URL(request.url);
    if (url.pathname === '/ensure-running') return this.ensureRunning(request);
    if (url.pathname === '/exec') return this.exec(request);
    return new Response('Not Found', { status: 404 });
  }

  async ensureRunning(request: Request): Promise<Response> {
    const { spaceId, userId, isEnterprise } = await request.json();
    
    if (isEnterprise) this.idleTimeoutMs = -1; // Never idle

    if (this.sandboxRef) {
      this.lastCommandAt = Date.now();
      return Response.json({ status: 'already_running' });
    }

    // Naming: naelao-asst-{spaceHex}-{userHex}
    const containerName = `naelao-asst-${spaceId.replace(/-/g, '').slice(0,8)}-${userId.replace(/-/g, '').slice(0,8)}`;
    this.sandboxRef = getSandbox(this.env.NAELAO_ASSISTANT_SANDBOX_CONT, containerName);

    // ── CRITICAL: Mount the Assistant's specific R2 path ──
    // This contains the assistant's memory.json, custom skills, and cron-jobs.json
    await this.sandboxRef.mountBucket(
      this.env.NAELAO_WORKSPACE,
      '/data/assistant',
      { prefix: `spaces/${spaceId}/assistants/${userId}/` }
    );

    // Start the Moltworker bridge script (establishes WS back to AssistantDO)
    await this.sandboxRef.exec('bash', ['/opt/naelao/assistant-bridge.sh'], {
      env: {
        SPACE_ID: spaceId,
        USER_ID: userId,
        INTERNAL_TOKEN: this.env.NAELAO_INTERNAL_TOKEN
      }
    });

    this.lastCommandAt = Date.now();
    if (this.idleTimeoutMs > 0) {
      await this.ctx.storage.setAlarm(Date.now() + this.idleTimeoutMs);
    }

    return Response.json({ status: 'started', containerName });
  }

  // Exec method is identical to SandboxDO, ensuring argument arrays are used.
  async exec(request: Request): Promise<Response> {
    if (!this.sandboxRef) return new Response('Not running', { status: 503 });
    const { command, args, cwd } = await request.json();

    const result = await this.sandboxRef.exec(command, args, { cwd: cwd ?? '/data/assistant' });
    this.lastCommandAt = Date.now();

    return Response.json({
      exitCode: result.exitCode,
      stdout: result.stdout,
      stderr: result.stderr
    });
  }

  async alarm() {
    if (this.idleTimeoutMs < 0) return; // Enterprise: do nothing

    if (Date.now() - this.lastCommandAt >= this.idleTimeoutMs) {
      if (this.sandboxRef) {
        await this.sandboxRef.terminate();
        this.sandboxRef = null;
      }
    } else {
      // Reset alarm
      await this.ctx.storage.setAlarm(this.lastCommandAt + this.idleTimeoutMs);
    }
  }
}
86 — Core Engine Details

AgentPress Error Processor — The 30+ Error Catalog

If an agent crashes every time a tool throws an error, it is useless. The AgentPress Error Processor intercepts every raw error (from HTTP timeouts to Python syntax errors to LLM hallucinated XML tags), standardizes them, and feeds them back to the LLM as a correction prompt. This is how agents learn to self-correct.

The LLM Empathy Rule

LLMs cannot debug raw stack traces efficiently without context. If a file read fails because the path was absolute instead of relative, returning ENOENT: /workspace/file.txt causes the LLM to hallucinate files. Returning Tool Error: File not found. You provided an absolute path starting with '/'. Remember that file-manager paths must be relative to workspace. allows the LLM to fix it instantly on the next turn.

Error Processor Implementation

// agentpress/error-processor.ts

export interface ProcessedError {
  code: string;
  category: 'tool' | 'llm' | 'system' | 'security' | 'network';
  agentMessage: string;    // What we tell the LLM so it can self-correct
  shouldRetry: boolean;    // Whether the orchestrator should automatically retry
  isFatal: boolean;        // Whether this kills the entire run (e.g., Wallet Empty)
}

export function processAgentException(error: Error, context: any): ProcessedError {
  const msg = error.message;

  // ── 1. Security & Permissions (Fatal) ──
  if (msg.includes('path traversal')) {
    return {
      code: 'ERR_PATH_TRAVERSAL',
      category: 'security',
      agentMessage: `Security Error: You attempted a path traversal ('..'). This is blocked. Only access files inside your permitted workspace.`,
      shouldRetry: false,
      isFatal: false
    };
  }
  if (msg.includes('Wallet denied')) {
    return {
      code: 'ERR_WALLET_EMPTY',
      category: 'security',
      agentMessage: `Payment Error: The workspace wallet does not have enough funds to complete this action. Stop the task and ask the user to add funds.`,
      shouldRetry: false,
      isFatal: true
    };
  }

  // ── 2. Tool Syntax & Execution Errors ──
  if (msg.includes('JSON parse error') || msg.includes('malformed XML')) {
    return {
      code: 'ERR_TOOL_SYNTAX',
      category: 'llm',
      agentMessage: `Tool Error: You output malformed JSON or XML. Please ensure your tool call exactly matches the schema provided. Do not include markdown formatting around the XML.`,
      shouldRetry: true,
      isFatal: false
    };
  }
  if (msg.includes('missing required parameter')) {
    return {
      code: 'ERR_MISSING_PARAM',
      category: 'tool',
      agentMessage: `Tool Error: ${msg}. Review the tool definition and try again.`,
      shouldRetry: false,
      isFatal: false
    };
  }
  if (msg.includes('Exit code: 1') && context.toolName === 'execute_python') {
    return {
      code: 'ERR_PYTHON_CRASH',
      category: 'tool',
      agentMessage: `Execution Error: Your Python script crashed. \nStderr:\n${context.stderr}\n\nFix the logic and rewrite the script.`,
      shouldRetry: false,
      isFatal: false
    };
  }

  // ── 3. File System Errors ──
  if (msg.includes('ENOENT') || msg.includes('File not found')) {
    const hasAbsPath = msg.includes('/workspace') || msg.includes('/home') || msg.startsWith('/');
    return {
      code: 'ERR_FILE_NOT_FOUND',
      category: 'tool',
      agentMessage: hasAbsPath
        ? `Tool Error: File not found. You used an absolute path starting with '/'. All paths must be relative to the workspace root. Example: use 'src/index.ts' not '/workspace/src/index.ts'.`
        : `Tool Error: File not found at the specified path. Check that the file exists by listing the directory first.`,
      shouldRetry: false,
      isFatal: false
    };
  }
  if (msg.includes('EACCES') || msg.includes('Permission denied')) {
    return {
      code: 'ERR_FILE_PERMISSION',
      category: 'security',
      agentMessage: `Tool Error: Permission denied. You cannot read or write outside of your permitted workspace. If you need to install a package, use 'execute_bash' with 'npm install' in the workspace directory.`,
      shouldRetry: false,
      isFatal: false
    };
  }
  if (msg.includes('EISDIR')) {
    return {
      code: 'ERR_IS_DIRECTORY',
      category: 'tool',
      agentMessage: `Tool Error: The path you provided is a directory, not a file. Use 'list_directory' to see its contents, or provide a specific file path.`,
      shouldRetry: false,
      isFatal: false
    };
  }
  if (msg.includes('ENOSPC') || msg.includes('no space left')) {
    return {
      code: 'ERR_DISK_FULL',
      category: 'system',
      agentMessage: `System Error: The workspace storage is full. Delete unused files or compressed archives before proceeding.`,
      shouldRetry: false,
      isFatal: false
    };
  }

  // ── 4. Code Execution Errors ──
  if (msg.includes('Exit code: 1') && context.toolName === 'execute_bash') {
    return {
      code: 'ERR_BASH_NONZERO',
      category: 'tool',
      agentMessage: `Execution Error: The bash command exited with a non-zero status.\nStderr: ${context.stderr}\n\nAnalyze the error above and fix the command or script.`,
      shouldRetry: false,
      isFatal: false
    };
  }
  if (msg.includes('command not found')) {
    const cmd = msg.match(/'(.+?)': command not found/)?.[1] ?? 'the command';
    return {
      code: 'ERR_COMMAND_NOT_FOUND',
      category: 'tool',
      agentMessage: `Execution Error: '${cmd}' is not installed in the workspace container. Install it first with: apt-get install -y  or npm install -g . Then retry.`,
      shouldRetry: false,
      isFatal: false
    };
  }
  if (msg.includes('SyntaxError') && context.toolName === 'execute_python') {
    return {
      code: 'ERR_PYTHON_SYNTAX',
      category: 'tool',
      agentMessage: `Syntax Error in Python: ${msg}\n\nRewrite the script with correct Python 3 syntax. Do not use f-strings with backslashes inside the expression.`,
      shouldRetry: false,
      isFatal: false
    };
  }
  if (msg.includes('ModuleNotFoundError') || msg.includes('Cannot find module')) {
    const mod = msg.match(/No module named '(.+?)'|Cannot find module '(.+?)'/)?.[1] ?? 'unknown';
    return {
      code: 'ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND',
      category: 'tool',
      agentMessage: `Module Error: '${mod}' is not installed. Install it first:\n- Python: execute_bash with 'pip install ${mod}'\n- Node.js: execute_bash with 'npm install ${mod}'\nThen re-run your script.`,
      shouldRetry: false,
      isFatal: false
    };
  }
  if (msg.includes('timeout') && context.toolName === 'execute_bash') {
    return {
      code: 'ERR_EXEC_TIMEOUT',
      category: 'system',
      agentMessage: `Timeout Error: The command timed out after 60 seconds. If you are running a long-lived process, use backgroundMode or break the task into smaller steps.`,
      shouldRetry: false,
      isFatal: false
    };
  }

  // ── 5. API & Network Errors ──
  if (msg.includes('429') || msg.includes('Too Many Requests')) {
    return {
      code: 'ERR_RATE_LIMIT',
      category: 'network',
      agentMessage: `Network Error: The external API rate limited you (429). Pause for a moment before retrying. If this persists, reduce the frequency of calls or use batch endpoints.`,
      shouldRetry: true, // Orchestrator handles the actual backoff sleep
      isFatal: false
    };
  }
  if (msg.includes('401') || msg.includes('Unauthorized')) {
    return {
      code: 'ERR_API_UNAUTHORIZED',
      category: 'network',
      agentMessage: `Authentication Error: The API returned 401 Unauthorized. The credential may be expired or incorrect. Ask the user to re-enter the API key via the credentials manager.`,
      shouldRetry: false,
      isFatal: false
    };
  }
  if (msg.includes('403') || msg.includes('Forbidden')) {
    return {
      code: 'ERR_API_FORBIDDEN',
      category: 'network',
      agentMessage: `Authorization Error: The API returned 403 Forbidden. The credential lacks the required scopes or permissions. Do not retry — inform the user to grant the correct permissions.`,
      shouldRetry: false,
      isFatal: false
    };
  }
  if (msg.includes('404') || msg.includes('Not Found')) {
    return {
      code: 'ERR_API_NOT_FOUND',
      category: 'network',
      agentMessage: `Resource Error: The API returned 404 Not Found. The resource ID you used does not exist or has been deleted. Verify the ID before retrying.`,
      shouldRetry: false,
      isFatal: false
    };
  }
  if (msg.includes('500') || msg.includes('Internal Server Error')) {
    return {
      code: 'ERR_API_SERVER_ERROR',
      category: 'network',
      agentMessage: `External API Error: The upstream service returned a 500 Internal Server Error. This is not your fault. Wait 30 seconds and retry once. If it fails again, inform the user that the external service is experiencing issues.`,
      shouldRetry: true,
      isFatal: false
    };
  }
  if (msg.includes('ECONNREFUSED') || msg.includes('fetch failed') || msg.includes('network error')) {
    return {
      code: 'ERR_NETWORK_UNREACHABLE',
      category: 'network',
      agentMessage: `Network Error: Could not connect to the external service. Check that the URL is correct and the service is running. If you are trying to reach an internal service, use a Service Binding instead of fetch().`,
      shouldRetry: true,
      isFatal: false
    };
  }
  if (msg.includes('SSL') || msg.includes('certificate')) {
    return {
      code: 'ERR_SSL_FAILURE',
      category: 'network',
      agentMessage: `SSL Error: The connection failed due to a certificate issue. If accessing an internal service, ensure it uses a valid certificate. Self-signed certificates are not supported in the agent isolate.`,
      shouldRetry: false,
      isFatal: false
    };
  }

  // ── 6. Browser / Rendering Errors ──
  if (msg.includes('browser') && msg.includes('timeout')) {
    return {
      code: 'ERR_BROWSER_TIMEOUT',
      category: 'tool',
      agentMessage: `Browser Error: The page did not load within the timeout window. The site may be slow or require JavaScript that took too long. Try 'crawl_page' (which uses the raw HTTP response) instead of 'browser_navigate' if you only need the page content.`,
      shouldRetry: false,
      isFatal: false
    };
  }
  if (msg.includes('browser') && (msg.includes('blocked') || msg.includes('CAPTCHA'))) {
    return {
      code: 'ERR_BROWSER_BLOCKED',
      category: 'tool',
      agentMessage: `Browser Error: The website is blocking automated access (CAPTCHA or bot detection). You cannot bypass this. Inform the user that the site requires manual access or use the site's official API instead.`,
      shouldRetry: false,
      isFatal: false
    };
  }

  // ── 7. LLM & Context Errors ──
  if (msg.includes('context_length_exceeded') || msg.includes('too many tokens')) {
    return {
      code: 'ERR_CONTEXT_OVERFLOW',
      category: 'llm',
      agentMessage: `Context Error: The conversation is too long to continue in this session. Summarize the work done so far into a compact checkpoint document in the workspace, then start a new thread and reference the checkpoint.`,
      shouldRetry: false,
      isFatal: true
    };
  }
  if (msg.includes('overloaded') || msg.includes('model_unavailable')) {
    return {
      code: 'ERR_LLM_OVERLOADED',
      category: 'system',
      agentMessage: `AI Service: The model is temporarily overloaded. This is handled automatically — the system will retry with exponential backoff. No action needed.`,
      shouldRetry: true,
      isFatal: false
    };
  }
  if (msg.includes('content_filter') || msg.includes('safety')) {
    return {
      code: 'ERR_CONTENT_FILTER',
      category: 'llm',
      agentMessage: `Content Filter: The model's safety filter blocked this request. Rephrase the task to avoid triggering the content policy.`,
      shouldRetry: false,
      isFatal: false
    };
  }
  if (msg.includes('invalid_api_key') && msg.includes('anthropic')) {
    return {
      code: 'ERR_LLM_API_KEY',
      category: 'system',
      agentMessage: `Platform Error: The AI service API key is invalid. This is a platform configuration issue — the administrator must update the Anthropic API key in CF Secrets. This run cannot continue.`,
      shouldRetry: false,
      isFatal: true
    };
  }

  // ── 8. Data & Schema Validation Errors ──
  if (msg.includes('Zod') || msg.includes('validation error') || msg.includes('schema')) {
    return {
      code: 'ERR_SCHEMA_VALIDATION',
      category: 'tool',
      agentMessage: `Validation Error: The data you provided does not match the required schema. ${msg}. Review the tool's parameter specification and provide the correct types and fields.`,
      shouldRetry: false,
      isFatal: false
    };
  }
  if (msg.includes('unique constraint') || msg.includes('duplicate key')) {
    return {
      code: 'ERR_DUPLICATE_RECORD',
      category: 'tool',
      agentMessage: `Database Error: A record with this ID or unique field already exists. Use an UPDATE instead of INSERT, or choose a different identifier.`,
      shouldRetry: false,
      isFatal: false
    };
  }
  if (msg.includes('foreign key constraint')) {
    return {
      code: 'ERR_FOREIGN_KEY',
      category: 'tool',
      agentMessage: `Database Error: A foreign key constraint failed. You are referencing an ID that does not exist in the parent table. Create the parent record first before inserting this child record.`,
      shouldRetry: false,
      isFatal: false
    };
  }

  // ── 9. Platform Limits ──
  if (msg.includes('Max iterations')) {
    return {
      code: 'ERR_MAX_ITERATIONS',
      category: 'system',
      agentMessage: `System Alert: You have reached the maximum allowed steps for this task. You must summarize your progress and stop now. Write a handoff document to the workspace before stopping.`,
      shouldRetry: false,
      isFatal: true
    };
  }
  if (msg.includes('ConcurrencyDO') && msg.includes('limit')) {
    return {
      code: 'ERR_CONCURRENCY_LIMIT',
      category: 'system',
      agentMessage: `Concurrency Error: This space has reached its maximum number of simultaneous agent runs. Wait for an active run to complete before starting a new one.`,
      shouldRetry: false,
      isFatal: true
    };
  }
  if (msg.includes('R2') && msg.includes('size limit')) {
    return {
      code: 'ERR_R2_SIZE_LIMIT',
      category: 'system',
      agentMessage: `Storage Error: The file you are trying to write exceeds the per-object size limit (5 GB). Split the file into smaller chunks or use a streaming approach.`,
      shouldRetry: false,
      isFatal: false
    };
  }
  if (msg.includes('token budget') || msg.includes('daily limit')) {
    return {
      code: 'ERR_TOKEN_BUDGET',
      category: 'system',
      agentMessage: `Budget Error: This space has exhausted its daily LLM token budget. The agent cannot make more LLM calls today. The budget resets at midnight UTC. Inform the user.`,
      shouldRetry: false,
      isFatal: true
    };
  }

  // ── 10. Security Violations ──
  if (msg.includes('SSRF') || msg.includes('RFC 1918') || msg.includes('private IP')) {
    return {
      code: 'ERR_SSRF_BLOCKED',
      category: 'security',
      agentMessage: `Security Error: You attempted to make a request to a private or reserved IP address. Internal network access is blocked. Only public internet endpoints are accessible.`,
      shouldRetry: false,
      isFatal: false
    };
  }
  if (msg.includes('networkPolicy') || msg.includes('not in allowlist')) {
    return {
      code: 'ERR_NETWORK_POLICY',
      category: 'security',
      agentMessage: `Network Policy Error: The domain you tried to access is not in this Space Type's network allowlist. You can only access the following approved domains: ${context.allowlist?.join(', ') ?? 'see manifest'}. Ask the Space admin to update the allowlist if access is required.`,
      shouldRetry: false,
      isFatal: false
    };
  }
  if (msg.includes('WalletDO') && (msg.includes('vendor') || msg.includes('whitelist'))) {
    return {
      code: 'ERR_WALLET_VENDOR_BLOCKED',
      category: 'security',
      agentMessage: `Wallet Error: This vendor is not in your wallet's approved vendor list. The space admin must add this vendor to the wallet's whitelist before any payments can be sent to them.`,
      shouldRetry: false,
      isFatal: false
    };
  }

  // ── Fallback ──
  return {
    code: 'ERR_UNKNOWN',
    category: 'system',
    agentMessage: `An unexpected system error occurred: ${msg}. Try an alternative approach. If this recurs, inform the user and stop.`,
    shouldRetry: false,
    isFatal: false
  };
}
