Emergency Kill Switch: How AgentDO Checks It

The kill switch is stored in KV. AgentDO checks env.NAELAO_CONFIG_KV.get('emergency:kill-all-agents') at the top of every LLM loop iteration. Because KV reads are ~1ms at the edge, this adds negligible latency. If the key is present and active: true, the agent immediately writes status='emergency_halted' to D1 and throws an AgentEmergencyHaltError, which the run loop catches to drain the WebSocket gracefully.

92 — Worker Full Implementation: naelao-notifications

naelao-notifications — Omnichannel Alert Delivery: APNs, FCM, Slack, Discord, Resend, VAPI

The complete notification delivery engine. A pure CF Queue consumer — nothing calls it via HTTP. Every delivery channel is implemented in full: APNs JWT auth (not certificates), FCM HTTP v1 API, Slack Block Kit messages, Discord embeds, Resend templated email, and VAPI outbound voice escalation. Idempotency via KV prevents double-delivery on queue retry.

APNs: JWT Auth (Not Certs)

APNs supports two auth mechanisms: certificates (.p12) and JWT tokens signed with a .p8 key. Certificates expire every year and require renewal. JWT tokens are signed per-request using a long-lived ES256 private key that never expires (only the JWT itself expires in 60 min). Naelao uses JWT — zero renewal overhead, and the .p8 key stores cleanly as a CF Secret.

FCM v1 HTTP API

The legacy FCM API (v1 deprecated 2024) used a server key. The FCM HTTP v1 API uses OAuth2 service account tokens. Naelao generates a service account JWT, exchanges it for an access token (cached 55 min in KV), and calls https://fcm.googleapis.com/v1/projects/{project}/messages:send. The token refresh is transparent and never blocks delivery.

Complete Worker Implementation

// workers/notifications/index.ts
// Pure Queue consumer — no HTTP fetch() handler.
// Bindings: NAELAO_NOTIFICATIONS queue (consumer), NAELAO_CONFIG_KV, SPACE_DO, Secrets.

interface NotificationPayload {
  id: string;
  type: string;
  spaceId: string;
  userId?: string;
  to?: string;          // email address or phone
  channels: Array<'email' | 'push' | 'slack' | 'discord' | 'voice'>;
  message: string;
  title?: string;
  priority: 'normal' | 'high' | 'critical';
  metadata?: Record<string, any>;
}

interface Env {
  SPACE_DO: DurableObjectNamespace;  // per-product SpaceDO — replaces HYPERDRIVE + SUPABASE_*
  NAELAO_CONFIG_KV: KVNamespace;
  NAELAO_ANALYTICS_QUEUE: Queue;
  // Secrets
  APNS_KEY_ID: string;          // 10-char Key ID from Apple Developer
  APNS_TEAM_ID: string;         // 10-char Team ID
  APNS_BUNDLE_ID: string;       // e.g. dev.naelao.app
  APNS_PRIVATE_KEY: string;     // PEM content of .p8 file (ES256)
  FCM_SERVICE_ACCOUNT: string;  // JSON string of Firebase service account
  FCM_PROJECT_ID: string;
  RESEND_API_KEY: string;
  RESEND_FROM: string;          // e.g. "Naelao <noreply@naelao.dev>"
  VAPI_API_KEY: string;
  VAPI_PHONE_NUMBER_ID: string;
  // SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY removed — SpaceDO handles all data access
}

export default {
  async queue(batch: MessageBatch<NotificationPayload>, env: Env): Promise<void> {
    await Promise.allSettled(
      batch.messages.map(async msg => {
        try {
          await deliverNotification(msg.body, env);
          msg.ack();
        } catch (e) {
          console.error(`[notifications] delivery failed ${msg.body.id}:`, e);
          msg.retry();
        }
      })
    );
  }
};

async function deliverNotification(payload: NotificationPayload, env: Env): Promise<void> {
  // Idempotency: KV lock for 24h prevents double-send on at-least-once delivery
  const lockKey = `notif:sent:${payload.id}`;
  try { await env.NAELAO_CONFIG_KV.get(lockKey); } catch { /* key not found = not sent yet */ }
  const alreadySent = await env.NAELAO_CONFIG_KV.get(lockKey);
  if (alreadySent) return;

  const tasks: Promise<void>[] = [];

  if (payload.channels.includes('email') && payload.to) {
    tasks.push(sendEmail(payload, env));
  }
  if (payload.channels.includes('push') && payload.userId) {
    tasks.push(sendPush(payload, env));
  }
  if (payload.channels.includes('slack')) {
    tasks.push(sendSlack(payload, env));
  }
  if (payload.channels.includes('discord')) {
    tasks.push(sendDiscord(payload, env));
  }
  if (payload.channels.includes('voice') && payload.priority === 'critical') {
    tasks.push(sendVapiCall(payload, env));
  }

  await Promise.all(tasks);

  await env.NAELAO_CONFIG_KV.put(lockKey, '1', { expirationTtl: 86400 });
  await env.NAELAO_ANALYTICS_QUEUE.send({
    type: 'notification_delivered', notificationId: payload.id,
    spaceId: payload.spaceId, channels: payload.channels, ts: Date.now()
  });
}

// ── EMAIL via Resend ─────────────────────────────────────────
async function sendEmail(payload: NotificationPayload, env: Env): Promise<void> {
  const templates: Record<string, { subject: string; html: string }> = {
    credits_exhausted: {
      subject: '⚠️ Your Naelao Space has run out of credits',
      html: `<h2>Credits Exhausted</h2><p>${payload.message}</p><p><a href="https://app.naelao.dev/billing">Add credits →</a></p>`
    },
    trial_ending: {
      subject: '⏰ Your Naelao trial ends in 3 days',
      html: `<h2>Trial Ending Soon</h2><p>${payload.message}</p><p><a href="https://app.naelao.dev/billing">Upgrade now →</a></p>`
    },
    subscription_cancelled: {
      subject: 'Your Naelao subscription has been cancelled',
      html: `<h2>Subscription Cancelled</h2><p>${payload.message}</p><p><a href="https://app.naelao.dev/billing">Resubscribe →</a></p>`
    },
    finetune_complete: {
      subject: '🎉 Your fine-tuned model is ready',
      html: `<h2>Fine-Tune Complete</h2><p>${payload.message}</p><p><a href="https://app.naelao.dev/models">Use your model →</a></p>`
    },
    space_invite: {
      subject: `You've been invited to a Naelao Space`,
      html: `<h2>Space Invitation</h2><p>${payload.message}</p>`
    },
    default: {
      subject: payload.title ?? 'Naelao Notification',
      html: `<p>${payload.message}</p>`
    }
  };

  const tmpl = templates[payload.type] ?? templates.default;
  const baseHtml = `<!DOCTYPE html><html><body style="font-family:sans-serif;max-width:600px;margin:0 auto;padding:32px">
    <img src="https://app.naelao.dev/logo.png" height="32" alt="Naelao">
    <hr style="margin:24px 0">
    ${tmpl.html}
    <hr style="margin:24px 0">
    <p style="color:#666;font-size:12px">Naelao · <a href="https://app.naelao.dev/settings/notifications">Manage notifications</a></p>
  </body></html>`;

  const resp = await fetch('https://api.resend.com/emails', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${env.RESEND_API_KEY}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ from: env.RESEND_FROM, to: payload.to, subject: tmpl.subject, html: baseHtml })
  });
  if (!resp.ok) throw new Error(`Resend failed: ${resp.status} ${await resp.text()}`);
}

// ── PUSH NOTIFICATIONS (APNs + FCM) ─────────────────────────
async function sendPush(payload: NotificationPayload, env: Env): Promise<void> {
  // Look up the user's registered device tokens from SpaceDO SQLite
  const resp = await fetch(
    spaceDO.getActiveDeviceTokens(payload.userId)
  );
  const tokens: Array<{ token: string; platform: 'ios' | 'android' }> = await resp.json();
  if (!tokens.length) return;

  await Promise.allSettled(
    tokens.map(({ token, platform }) =>
      platform === 'ios' ? sendApns(token, payload, env) : sendFcm(token, payload, env)
    )
  );
}

async function sendApns(deviceToken: string, payload: NotificationPayload, env: Env): Promise<void> {
  // Generate APNs JWT (valid 60 min, cached in KV)
  const jwtKey = 'apns:jwt';
  let apnsJwt = await env.NAELAO_CONFIG_KV.get(jwtKey);
  if (!apnsJwt) {
    // Import the ES256 private key (.p8 content, PEM format)
    const pemContent = env.APNS_PRIVATE_KEY.replace(/-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----|-----END PRIVATE KEY-----|\n/g, '');
    const keyDer = Uint8Array.from(atob(pemContent), c => c.charCodeAt(0));
    const signingKey = await crypto.subtle.importKey('pkcs8', keyDer, { name: 'ECDSA', namedCurve: 'P-256' }, false, ['sign']);

    const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
    const header = btoa(JSON.stringify({ alg: 'ES256', kid: env.APNS_KEY_ID })).replace(/=/g, '').replace(/\+/g, '-').replace(/\//g, '_');
    const claims = btoa(JSON.stringify({ iss: env.APNS_TEAM_ID, iat: now })).replace(/=/g, '').replace(/\+/g, '-').replace(/\//g, '_');
    const data = new TextEncoder().encode(`${header}.${claims}`);
    const rawSig = await crypto.subtle.sign({ name: 'ECDSA', hash: 'SHA-256' }, signingKey, data);

    // DER-encoded ECDSA sig → raw P1363 R||S for APNs
    const sig = btoa(String.fromCharCode(...new Uint8Array(rawSig))).replace(/=/g, '').replace(/\+/g, '-').replace(/\//g, '_');
    apnsJwt = `${header}.${claims}.${sig}`;
    await env.NAELAO_CONFIG_KV.put(jwtKey, apnsJwt, { expirationTtl: 3000 }); // cache 50 min
  }

  const apnsEnv = payload.priority === 'critical' ? 'api' : 'api'; // api = prod, api.sandbox = dev
  const resp = await fetch(`https://${apnsEnv}.push.apple.com/3/device/${deviceToken}`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      'Authorization': `Bearer ${apnsJwt}`,
      'apns-topic': env.APNS_BUNDLE_ID,
      'apns-priority': payload.priority === 'critical' ? '10' : '5',
      'apns-push-type': 'alert',
      'content-type': 'application/json'
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      aps: {
        alert: { title: payload.title ?? 'Naelao', body: payload.message },
        sound: payload.priority === 'critical' ? 'critical.caf' : 'default',
        badge: 1
      },
      naelaoType: payload.type,
      spaceId: payload.spaceId
    })
  });
  if (!resp.ok) {
    const err = await resp.json() as any;
    console.error('[notifications] APNs error:', err.reason, 'token:', deviceToken.slice(-8));
    if (err.reason === 'BadDeviceToken' || err.reason === 'Unregistered') {
      // Mark token inactive in SpaceDO SQLite
      await spaceDO.deactivateDeviceToken(deviceToken);  // SpaceDO method — no Supabase REST
    }
  }
}

async function sendFcm(fcmToken: string, payload: NotificationPayload, env: Env): Promise<void> {
  // Get OAuth2 access token from service account (cached 55 min)
  const tokenKey = 'fcm:oauth-token';
  let accessToken = await env.NAELAO_CONFIG_KV.get(tokenKey);
  if (!accessToken) {
    const sa = JSON.parse(env.FCM_SERVICE_ACCOUNT);
    const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
    // Build JWT for OAuth2 token exchange
    const jwtHeader = btoa(JSON.stringify({ alg: 'RS256', typ: 'JWT' })).replace(/[=+\/]/g, c => c === '=' ? '' : c === '+' ? '-' : '_');
    const jwtClaims = btoa(JSON.stringify({
      iss: sa.client_email,
      scope: 'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/firebase.messaging',
      aud: 'https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token',
      iat: now, exp: now + 3600
    })).replace(/[=+\/]/g, c => c === '=' ? '' : c === '+' ? '-' : '_');

    const keyDer = Uint8Array.from(atob(sa.private_key.replace(/-----[^-]+-----|\\n/g, '')), c => c.charCodeAt(0));
    const signingKey = await crypto.subtle.importKey('pkcs8', keyDer, { name: 'RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5', hash: 'SHA-256' }, false, ['sign']);
    const sig = await crypto.subtle.sign('RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5', signingKey, new TextEncoder().encode(`${jwtHeader}.${jwtClaims}`));
    const jwtSig = btoa(String.fromCharCode(...new Uint8Array(sig))).replace(/[=+\/]/g, c => c === '=' ? '' : c === '+' ? '-' : '_');
    const assertionJwt = `${jwtHeader}.${jwtClaims}.${jwtSig}`;

    const tokenResp = await fetch('https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
      body: `grant_type=urn%3Aietf%3Aparams%3Aoauth%3Agrant-type%3Ajwt-bearer&assertion=${assertionJwt}`
    });
    const { access_token } = await tokenResp.json() as any;
    accessToken = access_token;
    await env.NAELAO_CONFIG_KV.put(tokenKey, accessToken, { expirationTtl: 3300 });
  }

  const resp = await fetch(`https://fcm.googleapis.com/v1/projects/${env.FCM_PROJECT_ID}/messages:send`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${accessToken}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      message: {
        token: fcmToken,
        notification: { title: payload.title ?? 'Naelao', body: payload.message },
        data: { type: payload.type, spaceId: payload.spaceId, priority: payload.priority },
        android: { priority: payload.priority === 'critical' ? 'HIGH' : 'NORMAL' }
      }
    })
  });
  if (!resp.ok) {
    const err = await resp.json() as any;
    if (err.error?.status === 'NOT_FOUND') {
      await spaceDO.deactivateDeviceToken(fcmToken);  // SpaceDO method — no Supabase REST
    }
    throw new Error(`FCM error: ${err.error?.status}`);
  }
}

// ── SLACK (Block Kit) ────────────────────────────────────────
async function sendSlack(payload: NotificationPayload, env: Env): Promise<void> {
  const webhookUrl = payload.metadata?.slackWebhookUrl;
  if (!webhookUrl) return;

  const colorMap: Record<string, string> = { normal: '#3B82F6', high: '#F59E0B', critical: '#EF4444' };
  const blocks = {
    attachments: [{
      color: colorMap[payload.priority] ?? '#3B82F6',
      blocks: [
        { type: 'section', text: { type: 'mrkdwn', text: `*${payload.title ?? 'Naelao Notification'}*\n${payload.message}` } },
        { type: 'context', elements: [{ type: 'mrkdwn', text: `Space: \`${payload.spaceId}\` · Type: \`${payload.type}\` · Priority: *${payload.priority}*` }] }
      ]
    }]
  };

  const resp = await fetch(webhookUrl, {
    method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(blocks)
  });
  if (!resp.ok) throw new Error(`Slack webhook failed: ${resp.status}`);
}

// ── DISCORD (Embeds) ─────────────────────────────────────────
async function sendDiscord(payload: NotificationPayload, env: Env): Promise<void> {
  const webhookUrl = payload.metadata?.discordWebhookUrl;
  if (!webhookUrl) return;

  const colorMap: Record<string, number> = { normal: 0x3B82F6, high: 0xF59E0B, critical: 0xEF4444 };
  const embed = {
    username: 'Naelao',
    embeds: [{
      title: payload.title ?? 'Naelao Notification',
      description: payload.message,
      color: colorMap[payload.priority] ?? 0x3B82F6,
      footer: { text: `Space: ${payload.spaceId} · ${payload.type}` },
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
    }]
  };
  const resp = await fetch(webhookUrl, {
    method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(embed)
  });
  if (!resp.ok) throw new Error(`Discord webhook failed: ${resp.status}`);
}

// ── VAPI VOICE ESCALATION ────────────────────────────────────
async function sendVapiCall(payload: NotificationPayload, env: Env): Promise<void> {
  const phoneNumber = payload.metadata?.phoneNumber ?? payload.to;
  if (!phoneNumber) {
    // Look up from SpaceDO SQLite if not in metadata
    if (!payload.userId) return;
    const phone = await spaceDO.getUserPhone(payload.userId);
    if (!phone) return;
  }

  const phone = phoneNumber ?? await spaceDO.getUserPhone(payload.userId);

  if (!phone) return;

  const resp = await fetch('https://api.vapi.ai/call/phone', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${env.VAPI_API_KEY}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      phoneNumberId: env.VAPI_PHONE_NUMBER_ID,
      customer: { number: phone },
      assistant: {
        firstMessage: `Hello. This is Naelao, your AI workspace assistant. I am calling with a critical alert: ${payload.message}. To acknowledge and dismiss this alert, say yes. To be connected to your workspace, say workspace.`,
        model: { provider: 'anthropic', model: 'claude-haiku-4-5-20251001', systemPrompt: 'You are a concise voice assistant for Naelao. If user says yes or acknowledge, confirm and end call politely. If workspace, say they can open the Naelao app. Keep responses under 2 sentences.' },
        voice: { provider: '11labs', voiceId: 'rachel' },
        endCallPhrases: ['goodbye', 'hang up', 'done', 'thanks'],
        maxDurationSeconds: 120
      }
    })
  });
  if (!resp.ok) throw new Error(`VAPI call failed: ${await resp.text()}`);
}

Device Token Registration (Frontend)

// apps/frontend/lib/push-registration.ts
// Called after user grants push permission (mobile or web)

export async function registerDeviceToken(token: string, platform: 'ios' | 'android' | 'web') {
  const session = await naelaoAuth.getSession();  // naelao-auth Worker, no Supabase dependency
  if (!session) return;

  await spaceDO.upsertDeviceToken({
    user_id: session.user.id,
    token,
    platform,
    is_active: true,
    registered_at: new Date().toISOString()
  }, { onConflict: 'token' });
}

SQL: device_tokens table

-- migrations/0005_device_tokens.sql
CREATE TABLE device_tokens (
  id          UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id     UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  token       TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  platform    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (platform IN ('ios','android','web')),
  is_active   BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  registered_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  last_used_at  TIMESTAMPTZ
);
CREATE INDEX idx_device_tokens_user ON device_tokens(user_id) WHERE is_active = true;
93 — Worker Full Implementation: naelao-billing (RevenueCat + Trial Cron + BYOK)

naelao-billing — RevenueCat Mobile IAP, Trial Expiry Cron, BYOK Credit Bypass

The §87 section covers Stripe and token usage. This section adds the three missing pieces: RevenueCat webhooks for mobile in-app purchases (iOS/Android), a scheduled() Cron handler for daily trial expiry checks, and the BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) credit bypass so users who supply their own Anthropic API key are not billed through Naelao's credit ledger.

RevenueCat Webhook Handler

Mobile users subscribe through Apple/Google. RevenueCat normalises the platform-specific receipts into unified webhook events. Naelao receives RevenueCat webhooks and maps them to the same subscription state machine as Stripe.

// Append to workers/billing/index.ts

// ── REVENUECAT WEBHOOK ────────────────────────────────────────
// RevenueCat sends: INITIAL_PURCHASE, RENEWAL, CANCELLATION, EXPIRATION,
// PRODUCT_CHANGE, BILLING_ISSUE, SUBSCRIBER_ALIAS, TRANSFER
app.post('/revenuecat/webhook', async (c) => {
  const authHeader = c.req.header('Authorization');
  if (authHeader !== `Bearer ${c.env.REVENUECAT_WEBHOOK_SECRET}`) {
    return c.text('Unauthorized', 401);
  }

  const event = await c.req.json() as any;
  const { event: rc } = event;
  const spaceDO = getProductDO(rootSpaceId, c.env);  // SpaceDO replaces Hyperdrive

  // RC stores the Naelao spaceId in the subscriber's app_user_id
  const spaceId = rc.app_user_id;
  if (!spaceId) return c.json({ error: 'No app_user_id in webhook' }, 400);

  const rcPlanMap: Record<string, string> = {
    'naelao_maker_monthly':     'maker',
    'naelao_pro_monthly':       'pro',
    'naelao_team_monthly':      'team',
    'naelao_maker_annual':      'maker',
    'naelao_pro_annual':        'pro',
  };
  const tier = rcPlanMap[rc.product_id] ?? 'free';

  switch (rc.type) {
    case 'INITIAL_PURCHASE':
    case 'RENEWAL': {
      await db.query(
        `UPDATE spaces SET plan=$1, rc_subscription_id=$2, status='active', trial_end=NULL WHERE id=$3`,
        [tier, rc.id, spaceId]
      );
      // Grant monthly credit top-up for paid plans
      const creditGrant: Record<string, number> = { maker: 20, pro: 50, team: 150 };
      const credits = creditGrant[tier] ?? 0;
      if (credits > 0) {
        await db.query(
          `INSERT INTO space_credits (space_id, balance_usd) VALUES ($1,$2)
           ON CONFLICT (space_id) DO UPDATE SET balance_usd=space_credits.balance_usd+$2, updated_at=NOW()`,
          [spaceId, credits]
        );
      }
      break;
    }
    case 'CANCELLATION':
    case 'EXPIRATION': {
      await db.query(`UPDATE spaces SET plan='free', status='downgraded', rc_subscription_id=NULL WHERE id=$1`, [spaceId]);
      await c.env.NAELAO_NOTIFICATIONS_QUEUE.send({
        id: `rc-cancelled-${spaceId}-${Date.now()}`, type: 'subscription_cancelled', spaceId,
        channels: ['email', 'push'], message: 'Your Naelao subscription has ended. Your Space is now on the Free plan.', priority: 'high'
      });
      break;
    }
    case 'BILLING_ISSUE': {
      await db.query(`UPDATE spaces SET status='payment_failed' WHERE id=$1`, [spaceId]);
      await c.env.NAELAO_NOTIFICATIONS_QUEUE.send({
        id: `rc-billing-${spaceId}-${Date.now()}`, type: 'payment_failed', spaceId,
        channels: ['email', 'push'], message: 'We could not charge your payment method. Please update your billing info.', priority: 'high'
      });
      break;
    }
    case 'PRODUCT_CHANGE': {
      const newTier = rcPlanMap[rc.new_product_id] ?? 'free';
      await db.query(`UPDATE spaces SET plan=$1 WHERE id=$2`, [newTier, spaceId]);
      break;
    }
  }

  return c.json({ received: true, type: rc.type });
});

// ── TRIAL EXPIRY CRON ─────────────────────────────────────────
// Runs daily via CF Cron Trigger: "0 2 * * *" (2am UTC)
// 1. Warn spaces with trials ending in 3 days
// 2. Expire trials that ended (no payment method attached)
// 3. Send renewal success notifications for subscriptions that renewed overnight
export default {
  ...app,

  async scheduled(event: ScheduledEvent, env: Env, ctx: ExecutionContext): Promise<void> {
    ctx.waitUntil(runDailyBillingMaintenance(env));
  }
};

async function runDailyBillingMaintenance(env: Env): Promise<void> {
  const spaceDO = getProductDO(rootSpaceId, env);  // SpaceDO replaces Hyperdrive

  // 1. Trial expiry warnings (3 days out)
  const { rows: expiring } = await db.query(
    `SELECT id, owner_id FROM spaces WHERE plan='free' AND trial_end BETWEEN NOW() AND NOW()+INTERVAL '3 days' AND status='active'`
  );
  for (const space of expiring) {
    await env.NAELAO_NOTIFICATIONS_QUEUE.send({
      id: `trial-warn-${space.id}-${Date.now()}`, type: 'trial_ending',
      spaceId: space.id, userId: space.owner_id, channels: ['email','push'],
      message: 'Your Naelao free trial ends in 3 days. Add a payment method to keep full access.',
      priority: 'normal'
    });
  }

  // 2. Actually expire overdue trials
  const { rows: expired } = await db.query(
    `UPDATE spaces SET status='trial_expired', plan='free'
     WHERE trial_end < NOW() AND status='active' AND plan='free' AND trial_end IS NOT NULL
     RETURNING id, owner_id`
  );
  for (const space of expired) {
    await env.NAELAO_NOTIFICATIONS_QUEUE.send({
      id: `trial-expired-${space.id}`, type: 'trial_expired',
      spaceId: space.id, userId: space.owner_id, channels: ['email','push'],
      message: 'Your Naelao free trial has ended. Upgrade to a paid plan to continue.',
      priority: 'high'
    });
  }

  // 3. Deactivate spaces that have been in payment_failed for > 14 days
  await db.query(
    `UPDATE spaces SET status='suspended'
     WHERE status='payment_failed' AND updated_at < NOW()-INTERVAL '14 days'`
  );

  console.log(`[billing-cron] Warned: ${expiring.length}, Expired: ${expired.length} trials`);
}

// ── BYOK CREDIT BYPASS ───────────────────────────────────────
// When a user brings their own Anthropic API key, AgentDO calls this endpoint
// to check if billing should be skipped. If BYOK is configured, the key is
// fetched from the encrypted credentials store and returned for injection.
app.get('/byok/:spaceId/anthropic', async (c) => {
  const { spaceId } = c.req.param();

  const stored = await c.env.NAELAO_CONFIG_KV.get(`byok:${spaceId}:anthropic`);
  if (!stored) return c.json({ hasByok: false });

  const { encryptedKey, iv } = JSON.parse(stored);
  // Decrypt with space-specific key derived from NAELAO_MASTER_KEY + spaceId
  const masterKey = await crypto.subtle.importKey('raw', new TextEncoder().encode(c.env.NAELAO_MASTER_KEY), 'HKDF', false, ['deriveKey']);
  const spaceKey = await crypto.subtle.deriveKey(
    { name: 'HKDF', salt: new TextEncoder().encode(spaceId), info: new TextEncoder().encode('byok-anthropic'), hash: 'SHA-256' },
    masterKey, { name: 'AES-GCM', length: 256 }, false, ['decrypt']
  );
  const decrypted = await crypto.subtle.decrypt({ name: 'AES-GCM', iv: Uint8Array.from(atob(iv), c => c.charCodeAt(0)) }, spaceKey, Uint8Array.from(atob(encryptedKey), c => c.charCodeAt(0)));
  const apiKey = new TextDecoder().decode(decrypted);

  return c.json({ hasByok: true, apiKey });
});

app.post('/byok/:spaceId/anthropic', async (c) => {
  const { spaceId } = c.req.param();
  const { apiKey } = await c.req.json();

  // Validate the key is a real Anthropic key before storing
  const testResp = await fetch('https://api.anthropic.com/v1/models', {
    headers: { 'x-api-key': apiKey, 'anthropic-version': '2023-06-01' }
  });
  if (!testResp.ok) return c.json({ error: 'Invalid Anthropic API key' }, 400);

  const iv = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(12));
  const masterKey = await crypto.subtle.importKey('raw', new TextEncoder().encode(c.env.NAELAO_MASTER_KEY), 'HKDF', false, ['deriveKey']);
  const spaceKey = await crypto.subtle.deriveKey(
    { name: 'HKDF', salt: new TextEncoder().encode(spaceId), info: new TextEncoder().encode('byok-anthropic'), hash: 'SHA-256' },
    masterKey, { name: 'AES-GCM', length: 256 }, false, ['encrypt']
  );
  const encrypted = await crypto.subtle.encrypt({ name: 'AES-GCM', iv }, spaceKey, new TextEncoder().encode(apiKey));

  await c.env.NAELAO_CONFIG_KV.put(`byok:${spaceId}:anthropic`, JSON.stringify({
    encryptedKey: btoa(String.fromCharCode(...new Uint8Array(encrypted))),
    iv: btoa(String.fromCharCode(...iv)),
    storedAt: new Date().toISOString()
  }));

  return c.json({ success: true, message: 'BYOK key stored. Token usage will not be billed through Naelao credits.' });
});

Billing Flow Decision Tree

AgentDO: Which Key to Use, How to Bill
AgentDO starts LLM call
→
GET /byok/{spaceId}/anthropic
hasByok: true
→ use returned key, skip /token-usage →
No billing deducted
hasByok: false
→ use platform Anthropic key →
POST /token-usage after completion
credits_exhausted in response
→
Halt agent, notify user
94 — Worker Full Implementation: naelao-spaces (Delete, Archive, Role Change, Settings)

naelao-spaces — Delete, Archive, Role Change & Space Settings Endpoints

The §88 section covers create/read/invite/remove/resources. This section adds the missing write operations: cascading space deletion, soft-archiving, member role changes, and the space settings endpoint used by the frontend Settings panel.

// Append to workers/spaces/index.ts

// ── DELETE SPACE (cascading) ──────────────────────────────────
// 1. Cancel all running agent runs
// 2. Delete sub-spaces recursively (DB cascade handles this via FK)
// 3. Remove SpaceDO from memory (via alarm self-destruct)
// 4. Archive R2 workspace files (don't delete — move to cold archive)
// 5. Mark space as deleted in DB
app.delete('/spaces/:spaceId', async (c) => {
  const { spaceId } = c.req.param();
  const { confirmedByUserId } = await c.req.json();
  const spaceDO = getProductDO(rootSpaceId, c.env);  // SpaceDO replaces Hyperdrive

  // Verify requester is the owner
  const { rows: ownerRows } = await db.query(
    `SELECT owner_id, name FROM spaces WHERE id=$1`, [spaceId]
  );
  if (!ownerRows.length) return c.json({ error: 'Space not found' }, 404);
  if (ownerRows[0].owner_id !== confirmedByUserId) return c.json({ error: 'Only the space owner can delete it' }, 403);

  // Cancel running agents
  const { rows: cancelledRuns } = await db.query(
    `UPDATE agent_runs SET status='cancelled', completed_at=NOW()
     WHERE space_id=$1 AND status='running' RETURNING id`, [spaceId]
  );

  // Get list of all sub-spaces to tear down their DOs
  const { rows: allSpaces } = await db.query(
    `WITH RECURSIVE tree AS (
       SELECT id FROM spaces WHERE id=$1
       UNION ALL
       SELECT s.id FROM spaces s JOIN tree t ON s.parent_space_id=t.id
     ) SELECT id FROM tree`, [spaceId]
  );

  // Soft delete — mark as deleted but keep DB records for audit
  await db.query(`UPDATE spaces SET status='deleted', deleted_at=NOW() WHERE id=ANY($1::uuid[])`, [allSpaces.map(r => r.id)]);

  // Archive R2 workspace: move files to archive prefix (async)
  c.executionCtx.waitUntil((async () => {
    const listed = await c.env.NAELAO_WORKSPACE.list({ prefix: `spaces/${spaceId}/` });
    for (const obj of listed.objects) {
      const data = await c.env.NAELAO_WORKSPACE.get(obj.key);
      if (data) {
        await c.env.NAELAO_WORKSPACE.put(`archive/${spaceId}/${obj.key}`, data.body);
        await c.env.NAELAO_WORKSPACE.delete(obj.key);
      }
    }
  })());

  // Tear down SpaceDOs for all sub-spaces
  await Promise.allSettled(
    allSpaces.map(({ id }) =>
      c.env.NAELAO_SPACE_DO.get(c.env.NAELAO_SPACE_DO.idFromName(`space:${id}`))
        .fetch(new Request('http://space/self-destruct', { method: 'POST' }))
    )
  );

  return c.json({
    success: true, spaceId, subSpacesDeleted: allSpaces.length - 1,
    agentRunsCancelled: cancelledRuns.length,
    message: 'Space deleted. R2 workspace files are archived for 90 days.'
  });
});

// ── ARCHIVE (soft suspend — reversible) ─────────────────────
app.post('/spaces/:spaceId/archive', async (c) => {
  const { spaceId } = c.req.param();
  const spaceDO = getProductDO(rootSpaceId, c.env);  // SpaceDO replaces Hyperdrive
  await db.query(`UPDATE spaces SET status='archived', archived_at=NOW() WHERE id=$1`, [spaceId]);
  await db.query(`UPDATE agent_runs SET status='cancelled', completed_at=NOW() WHERE space_id=$1 AND status='running'`, [spaceId]);
  const spaceDO = c.env.NAELAO_SPACE_DO.get(c.env.NAELAO_SPACE_DO.idFromName(`space:${spaceId}`));
  await spaceDO.fetch(new Request('http://space/force-status', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ status: 'archived' }) }));
  return c.json({ success: true, status: 'archived' });
});

app.post('/spaces/:spaceId/unarchive', async (c) => {
  const { spaceId } = c.req.param();
  const spaceDO = getProductDO(rootSpaceId, c.env);  // SpaceDO replaces Hyperdrive
  await db.query(`UPDATE spaces SET status='active', archived_at=NULL WHERE id=$1 AND status='archived'`, [spaceId]);
  const spaceDO = c.env.NAELAO_SPACE_DO.get(c.env.NAELAO_SPACE_DO.idFromName(`space:${spaceId}`));
  await spaceDO.fetch(new Request('http://space/force-status', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ status: 'active' }) }));
  return c.json({ success: true, status: 'active' });
});

// ── MEMBER ROLE CHANGE ───────────────────────────────────────
app.patch('/spaces/:spaceId/members/:targetUserId/role', async (c) => {
  const { spaceId, targetUserId } = c.req.param();
  const { newRole, requestingUserId } = await c.req.json();
  const spaceDO = getProductDO(rootSpaceId, c.env);  // SpaceDO replaces Hyperdrive

  const VALID_ROLES = ['admin', 'editor', 'viewer', 'agent'];
  if (!VALID_ROLES.includes(newRole)) return c.json({ error: `Invalid role. Must be one of: ${VALID_ROLES.join(', ')}` }, 400);

  // Only owner or admin can change roles
  const { rows: reqRows } = await db.query(`SELECT role FROM space_members WHERE space_id=$1 AND user_id=$2`, [spaceId, requestingUserId]);
  if (!reqRows.length || !['owner','admin'].includes(reqRows[0].role)) {
    return c.json({ error: 'Only space owner or admin can change member roles' }, 403);
  }

  // Cannot demote owner via this endpoint — use /transfer-ownership
  const { rows: targetRows } = await db.query(`SELECT role FROM space_members WHERE space_id=$1 AND user_id=$2`, [spaceId, targetUserId]);
  if (!targetRows.length) return c.json({ error: 'Member not found' }, 404);
  if (targetRows[0].role === 'owner') return c.json({ error: 'Cannot change owner role. Use /transfer-ownership.' }, 400);

  await db.query(`UPDATE space_members SET role=$1, updated_at=NOW() WHERE space_id=$2 AND user_id=$3`, [newRole, spaceId, targetUserId]);
  const spaceDO = c.env.NAELAO_SPACE_DO.get(c.env.NAELAO_SPACE_DO.idFromName(`space:${spaceId}`));
  await spaceDO.fetch(new Request('http://space/invalidate-member-cache', { method: 'POST' }));
  return c.json({ success: true, userId: targetUserId, newRole });
});

// ── TRANSFER OWNERSHIP ───────────────────────────────────────
app.post('/spaces/:spaceId/transfer-ownership', async (c) => {
  const { spaceId } = c.req.param();
  const { currentOwnerId, newOwnerId } = await c.req.json();
  const spaceDO = getProductDO(rootSpaceId, c.env);  // SpaceDO replaces Hyperdrive

  const { rows } = await db.query(`SELECT owner_id FROM spaces WHERE id=$1`, [spaceId]);
  if (!rows.length) return c.json({ error: 'Space not found' }, 404);
  if (rows[0].owner_id !== currentOwnerId) return c.json({ error: 'Only current owner can transfer ownership' }, 403);

  await db.query('BEGIN');
  try {
    await db.query(`UPDATE spaces SET owner_id=$1 WHERE id=$2`, [newOwnerId, spaceId]);
    await db.query(`UPDATE space_members SET role='owner' WHERE space_id=$1 AND user_id=$2`, [spaceId, newOwnerId]);
    await db.query(`UPDATE space_members SET role='admin' WHERE space_id=$1 AND user_id=$2`, [spaceId, currentOwnerId]);
    await db.query('COMMIT');
  } catch (e) {
    await db.query('ROLLBACK');
    throw e;
  }
  const spaceDO = c.env.NAELAO_SPACE_DO.get(c.env.NAELAO_SPACE_DO.idFromName(`space:${spaceId}`));
  await spaceDO.fetch(new Request('http://space/invalidate-member-cache', { method: 'POST' }));
  return c.json({ success: true, newOwnerId });
});

// ── SPACE SETTINGS (GET + PATCH) ─────────────────────────────
// The Settings panel in the frontend reads/writes here.
// Settings: display name, description, AI model preference, agent behavior, notification prefs.
app.get('/spaces/:spaceId/settings', async (c) => {
  const { spaceId } = c.req.param();
  const spaceDO = getProductDO(rootSpaceId, c.env);  // SpaceDO replaces Hyperdrive
  const { rows } = await db.query(
    `SELECT s.name, s.description, s.plan, s.status, s.space_type_id,
            sc.settings_json, sc.balance_usd AS credits_usd
     FROM spaces s
     LEFT JOIN space_configs sc ON sc.space_id=s.id
     LEFT JOIN space_credits sc2 ON sc2.space_id=s.id
     WHERE s.id=$1`, [spaceId]
  );
  if (!rows.length) return c.json({ error: 'Space not found' }, 404);
  const row = rows[0];
  return c.json({
    spaceId,
    name: row.name,
    description: row.description,
    plan: row.plan,
    status: row.status,
    spaceTypeId: row.space_type_id,
    creditsUsd: row.credits_usd ?? 0,
    settings: JSON.parse(row.settings_json ?? '{}')
  });
});

app.patch('/spaces/:spaceId/settings', async (c) => {
  const { spaceId } = c.req.param();
  const { name, description, settings } = await c.req.json();
  const spaceDO = getProductDO(rootSpaceId, c.env);  // SpaceDO replaces Hyperdrive

  if (name || description) {
    await db.query(
      `UPDATE spaces SET name=COALESCE($1,name), description=COALESCE($2,description), updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=$3`,
      [name ?? null, description ?? null, spaceId]
    );
  }
  if (settings) {
    await db.query(
      `INSERT INTO space_configs (space_id, settings_json, updated_at) VALUES ($1,$2,NOW())
       ON CONFLICT (space_id) DO UPDATE SET settings_json=$2, updated_at=NOW()`,
      [spaceId, JSON.stringify(settings)]
    );
  }
  return c.json({ success: true });
});

// ── LIST MY SPACES ────────────────────────────────────────────
app.get('/users/:userId/spaces', async (c) => {
  const { userId } = c.req.param();
  const { includeArchived = 'false' } = c.req.query();
  const spaceDO = getProductDO(rootSpaceId, c.env);  // SpaceDO replaces Hyperdrive
  const { rows } = await db.query(
    `SELECT s.id, s.name, s.description, s.space_type_id, s.plan, s.status, s.created_at,
            sm.role, s.parent_space_id,
            (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM space_members sm2 WHERE sm2.space_id=s.id) AS member_count
     FROM spaces s
     JOIN space_members sm ON sm.space_id=s.id AND sm.user_id=$1
     WHERE ($2='true' OR s.status NOT IN ('archived','deleted'))
     AND s.status != 'deleted'
     ORDER BY sm.role='owner' DESC, s.created_at DESC`,
    [userId, includeArchived]
  );
  return c.json({ spaces: rows });
});
95 — Worker Full Implementation: naelao-together-ai (Streaming Proxy, BYOK Injection, Model Health)

naelao-together-ai — Streaming Chat Proxy, BYOK Key Injection & Model Availability Polling

The §89 section covers the model selector, fine-tune launch/status, and AutoResearch agent. This section adds: the streaming /chat proxy endpoint (SSE passthrough), BYOK Together AI key injection per request, and a scheduled() Cron handler that polls Together AI for model availability and writes results to KV so the frontend model selector reflects real-time availability.

// Append to workers/together-ai/index.ts

// ── STREAMING CHAT PROXY ──────────────────────────────────────
// Used by AgentDO when the Space's active model is an open-source model.
// Proxies the Together AI streaming response directly to the caller.
// The caller is always AgentDO (via Service Binding), never the public internet.
app.post('/chat', async (c) => {
  const { spaceId, model, messages, maxTokens = 2000, temperature = 0.7, stream = true } = await c.req.json();

  const apiKey = await getApiKey(spaceId, c.env);

  const togetherReq = {
    model: MODEL_MAP[model as keyof typeof MODEL_MAP] ?? model,
    messages,
    max_tokens: maxTokens,
    temperature,
    stream
  };

  const resp = await fetch('https://api.together.xyz/v1/chat/completions', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${apiKey}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify(togetherReq)
  });

  if (!resp.ok) {
    const err = await resp.text();
    return c.json({ error: `Together AI error: ${err}` }, resp.status as any);
  }

  if (!stream) {
    return c.json(await resp.json());
  }

  // Stream: pass the SSE stream directly back to AgentDO.
  // We wrap in a TransformStream to inject billing accounting at the end.
  let inputTokens = 0, outputTokens = 0;

  const { readable, writable } = new TransformStream();
  const writer = writable.getWriter();
  const encoder = new TextEncoder();

  c.executionCtx.waitUntil((async () => {
    const reader = resp.body!.getReader();
    const decoder = new TextDecoder();
    let buffer = '';

    while (true) {
      const { done, value } = await reader.read();
      if (done) break;

      buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
      const lines = buffer.split('\n');
      buffer = lines.pop() ?? '';

      for (const line of lines) {
        if (!line.startsWith('data: ')) continue;
        const data = line.slice(6);
        if (data === '[DONE]') {
          await writer.write(encoder.encode('data: [DONE]\n\n'));
          continue;
        }
        try {
          const chunk = JSON.parse(data);
          // Accumulate token counts from usage field (present in final chunk)
          if (chunk.usage) {
            inputTokens = chunk.usage.prompt_tokens ?? 0;
            outputTokens = chunk.usage.completion_tokens ?? 0;
          }
          await writer.write(encoder.encode(`data: ${data}\n\n`));
        } catch {
          await writer.write(encoder.encode(`data: ${data}\n\n`));
        }
      }
    }
    await writer.close();

    // Post-stream billing (fire-and-forget via Analytics Queue)
    if (inputTokens > 0 || outputTokens > 0) {
      await c.env.NAELAO_ANALYTICS_QUEUE.send({
        type: 'token_usage_together',
        spaceId, model, inputTokens, outputTokens,
        ts: Date.now()
      });
      // Also deduct from billing Worker
      await c.env.NAELAO_BILLING.fetch(new Request('http://billing/token-usage', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({ spaceId, model, inputTokens, outputTokens, agentId: 'together-ai-proxy' })
      }));
    }
  })());

  return new Response(readable, {
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream',
      'Cache-Control': 'no-cache',
      'Connection': 'keep-alive'
    }
  });
});

// ── BYOK KEY MANAGEMENT (Together AI) ───────────────────────
async function getApiKey(spaceId: string, env: Env): Promise<string> {
  // Check for space-level BYOK Together AI key first
  const byokKey = await env.NAELAO_CONFIG_KV.get(`byok:${spaceId}:together-ai`);
  if (byokKey) {
    const { encryptedKey, iv } = JSON.parse(byokKey);
    const masterKey = await crypto.subtle.importKey('raw', new TextEncoder().encode(env.NAELAO_MASTER_KEY), 'HKDF', false, ['deriveKey']);
    const spaceKey = await crypto.subtle.deriveKey(
      { name: 'HKDF', salt: new TextEncoder().encode(spaceId), info: new TextEncoder().encode('byok-together-ai'), hash: 'SHA-256' },
      masterKey, { name: 'AES-GCM', length: 256 }, false, ['decrypt']
    );
    const decrypted = await crypto.subtle.decrypt(
      { name: 'AES-GCM', iv: Uint8Array.from(atob(iv), c => c.charCodeAt(0)) },
      spaceKey,
      Uint8Array.from(atob(encryptedKey), c => c.charCodeAt(0))
    );
    return new TextDecoder().decode(decrypted);
  }
  // Fall back to Naelao's platform key
  return env.TOGETHER_AI_API_KEY;
}

app.post('/byok/:spaceId', async (c) => {
  const { spaceId } = c.req.param();
  const { apiKey } = await c.req.json();

  // Validate key against Together AI
  const testResp = await fetch('https://api.together.xyz/v1/models', {
    headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${apiKey}` }
  });
  if (!testResp.ok) return c.json({ error: 'Invalid Together AI API key' }, 400);

  const iv = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(12));
  const masterKey = await crypto.subtle.importKey('raw', new TextEncoder().encode(c.env.NAELAO_MASTER_KEY), 'HKDF', false, ['deriveKey']);
  const spaceKey = await crypto.subtle.deriveKey(
    { name: 'HKDF', salt: new TextEncoder().encode(spaceId), info: new TextEncoder().encode('byok-together-ai'), hash: 'SHA-256' },
    masterKey, { name: 'AES-GCM', length: 256 }, false, ['encrypt']
  );
  const encrypted = await crypto.subtle.encrypt({ name: 'AES-GCM', iv }, spaceKey, new TextEncoder().encode(apiKey));
  await c.env.NAELAO_CONFIG_KV.put(`byok:${spaceId}:together-ai`, JSON.stringify({
    encryptedKey: btoa(String.fromCharCode(...new Uint8Array(encrypted))),
    iv: btoa(String.fromCharCode(...iv))
  }));
  return c.json({ success: true });
});

// ── MODEL AVAILABILITY + SELECTOR ───────────────────────────
app.get('/models', async (c) => {

  const cached = await c.env.NAELAO_CONFIG_KV.get('together-ai:model-availability');

  // Augment with space's fine-tuned models if spaceId provided

    const { rows } = await db.query(

      [spaceId]
    );
    fineTunedModels = rows;
  }

  return c.json({
    models: [
      { id: 'llama-3.1-8b',   name: 'Llama 3.1 8B',   provider: 'Meta',   contextWindow: 128_000, costTier: 'cheapest', ...availability['llama-3.1-8b']  },
      { id: 'llama-3.1-70b',  name: 'Llama 3.1 70B',  provider: 'Meta',   contextWindow: 128_000, costTier: 'medium',   ...availability['llama-3.1-70b'] },
      { id: 'qwen-2.5-72b',   name: 'Qwen 2.5 72B',   provider: 'Alibaba',contextWindow: 128_000, costTier: 'medium',   ...availability['qwen-2.5-72b']  },
      { id: 'deepseek-r1',    name: 'DeepSeek R1',    provider: 'DeepSeek',contextWindow: 64_000,  costTier: 'medium',   ...availability['deepseek-r1']   },
      { id: 'mixtral-8x22b',  name: 'Mixtral 8x22B',  provider: 'Mistral',contextWindow: 64_000,  costTier: 'medium',   ...availability['mixtral-8x22b'] },
    ],
    fineTunedModels,
    lastUpdated: availability._lastUpdated ?? null
  });
});

// ── CRON: MODEL AVAILABILITY POLLING ────────────────────────
// CF Cron Trigger: "*/15 * * * *" (every 15 minutes)
// Polls Together AI /v1/models to check which models are available.
// Writes to KV so model selector reflects real-time status.
export default {
  ...app,

  async scheduled(event: ScheduledEvent, env: Env, ctx: ExecutionContext): Promise<void> {
    ctx.waitUntil(pollModelAvailability(env));
  }
};

async function pollModelAvailability(env: Env): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const resp = await fetch('https://api.together.xyz/v1/models', {
      headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${env.TOGETHER_AI_API_KEY}` }
    });
    if (!resp.ok) { console.error('[together-ai-cron] Models API error:', resp.status); return; }
    const models: Array<{ id: string; display_name: string; context_length: number; pricing?: any }> = await resp.json();

    const monitoredIds = ['meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-Turbo', 'meta-llama/Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct-Turbo', 'Qwen/Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct-Turbo', 'deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1', 'mistralai/Mixtral-8x22B-Instruct-v0.1'];
    const availability: Record<string, any> = { _lastUpdated: new Date().toISOString() };

    const internalIds = ['llama-3.1-8b', 'llama-3.1-70b', 'qwen-2.5-72b', 'deepseek-r1', 'mixtral-8x22b'];
    for (let i = 0; i < monitoredIds.length; i++) {
      const found = models.find(m => m.id === monitoredIds[i]);
      availability[internalIds[i]] = {
        available: !!found,
        contextLength: found?.context_length ?? null,
        pricing: found?.pricing ?? null
      };
    }

    await env.NAELAO_CONFIG_KV.put('together-ai:model-availability', JSON.stringify(availability), { expirationTtl: 1800 });
    console.log('[together-ai-cron] Updated model availability for', internalIds.length, 'models');
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('[together-ai-cron] Poll failed:', e);
  }
}

Task Type Recommended Model Reason

48 — Business Architecture

The Three-Tier Platform Model

Naelao operates as a three-tier infrastructure platform. This is not a feature — it is the fundamental business architecture that governs every API call, every permission check, every billing calculation, and every data isolation guarantee in the system. Every developer working on this codebase must internalize this model before touching a single file.

Architectural Law — Not a Guideline

Every data access, every DO instantiation, every KV read, every R2 bucket operation, and every database query in the system is scoped to one of these three tiers. There is no operation in Naelao that is tier-agnostic. If you cannot identify which tier an operation belongs to, you have not understood the operation. Stop. Identify the tier. Then write the code.

Tier 0 — Naelao (Infrastructure Owner)

Naelao owns the execution environment entirely. Workers, Durable Objects, Cloudflare bindings, billing rails, auth primitives, the agent runtime, storage buckets, and the agent loop itself are all Tier 0 concerns. No Tier 1 builder can modify, bypass, or inspect this layer. Naelao is to builders what AWS is to Anthropic, what Stripe is to Shopify, what Twilio is to any application built on top of it. The infrastructure is invisible to end users and opaque to builders — they consume it through defined APIs only.

Tier 0 controls: the credit metering system, the agent execution loop, container orchestration, the AI gateway, the KV routing layer, all Cloudflare service bindings, the platform-level auth primitives (JWT signing keys, refresh token issuance), and the wholesale billing calculation engine.

Tier 1 — Builders (Product Owners)

Builders are companies or individuals who build complete products on top of Naelao infrastructure. They are the equivalent of Anthropic building Claude, Harvey AI building a legal product, Cursor building a coding assistant, or a SaaS founder building an industry-specific AI tool. A Tier 1 builder controls their end user pool and authentication flow, their product UI and custom domain, their agent configuration and system prompts, their pricing model and revenue strategy, and their admin functionality. They do not control: the infrastructure running their product, the agent loop execution model, the security boundaries between tenants, or Naelao's billing rates.

Builders pay Naelao at wholesale compute and credit rates. They charge their end users at whatever rates they choose. The margin between wholesale and retail is the builder's business model.

Tier 2 — End Users (Product Consumers)

End users sign into the Tier 1 product. They have zero awareness of Naelao. They use "LexSpace" or "CodePilot" or "FirmAI" — whatever the builder named and branded their product. Naelao branding is suppressed entirely at the product layer. End users are not Naelao platform users. They are product users. Their identity, sessions, data, and billing relationship are all scoped to the product they signed up for — not to Naelao.

Real-World Analog Infrastructure Owner Builder / Product Owner End User
Cloud hosting AWS Anthropic (builds Claude) Claude users
Payment rails Stripe Shopify (builds store platform) Merchant customers
Communications Twilio Developer app App end users
Deployment infra Vercel Startup product Startup customers
This platform Naelao Builder products Product users

The NaelaoProduct Entity — Complete TypeScript Interface

The NaelaoProduct is the core data model representing a Tier 1 builder's deployed product. It wraps a configured Space and adds the builder-facing control layer. Every field is required to be present in the database record. No nullable field may be omitted from API responses — return null explicitly. A junior developer must not add fields to this interface without a corresponding database migration and API contract update.

// ─── NaelaoProduct — complete interface ───────────────────────────────────────
// File: packages/naelao-types/src/product.ts

export type ProductAuthProvider =
  | 'naelao-native'   // Naelao's own auth system — fastest to ship
  | 'clerk'           // Clerk.dev integration
  | 'custom-oidc'     // Any OIDC-compliant identity provider
  | 'saml-sso';       // SAML 2.0 — enterprise / Google Workspace / Okta

export type ProductPricingType = 'free' | 'subscription' | 'credits' | 'seats';
export type BuilderBillingModel = 'usage-based' | 'flat-monthly';
export type ProductStatus = 'draft' | 'active' | 'suspended' | 'deleted';

export interface SsoConfig {
  oidcIssuerUrl: string | null;
  oidcClientId: string | null;
  oidcClientSecret: string | null; // stored encrypted in Cloudflare Secrets Store
  oidcScopes: string[];
  oidcUsernameClaim: string;
  samlEntryPoint: string | null;
  samlIssuer: string | null;
  samlCert: string | null;         // PEM format
  samlCallbackUrl: string | null;  // always https://{domain}/auth/saml/callback
  jitProvisioning: boolean;
  attributeMapping: Record<string, string>;
}

export interface ProductPricingConfig {
  type: ProductPricingType;
  pricePerSeat: number | null;              // USD cents per seat/month
  includedSeats: number | null;
  creditsIncludedPerMonth: number | null;
  overageCreditsPrice: number | null;       // USD cents per 1000 credits
  creditBundleOptions: CreditBundle[] | null;
  trialDays: number;

}

  priceUsdCents: number;

}

export interface ProductUserPermissions {

  canCreateSubSpaces: boolean;
  canInstallAgents: boolean;
  canUploadKnowledge: boolean;
  canViewOtherUsers: boolean;

}

export interface ProductAdminFeatures {

  agentConfiguration: boolean;
  knowledgeBaseManagement: boolean;

  featureFlagControl: boolean;
  customBranding: boolean;
  domainConfiguration: boolean;

}

export interface NaelaoProduct {
  // Identity
  id: string;
  builderId: string;
  spaceId: string;
  name: string;
  slug: string;
  domain: string;
  customDomainVerified: boolean;
  brandColor: string;
  logoUrl: string | null;
  faviconUrl: string | null;
  productDescription: string;
  // Auth
  authProvider: ProductAuthProvider;
  allowPublicSignup: boolean;

  ssoConfig: SsoConfig | null;
  // Pricing
  pricingConfig: ProductPricingConfig;

  builderBillingModel: BuilderBillingModel;

  // Permissions
  userPermissions: ProductUserPermissions;

  allowUserSubSpaces: boolean;
  subSpaceTerminology: string;    // "workspaces", "teams", "departments"
  maxSubSpaceDepth: 1 | 2;
  // White-label
  suppressNaelaoBranding: boolean;
  naelaoAttributionText: string | null;
  // conversationLogAccess gatekeeping
  conversationAccessApprovedBy: string | null;
  conversationAccessApprovedAt: string | null;
  // Status

  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
  launchedAt: string | null;

  suspendedReason: string | null;
